en: 8  The Market’s Place
zh: 8  市场的位置

en: The dominant theme in the description of the rural Third World at the close of the twentieth century remains the story of its capitalist transformation. The theme was exemplified in rural Egypt, where the reform and removal of state controls through the program known as structural adjustment was intended to turn the land and its produce into market commodities and remake the countryside for the twenty-first century as a fully capitalist economy. There are several ways to critique this story of capitalism’s advance. In the case of Egypt one can question how seriously some of the market reforms were applied, ask about the ways people resisted or evaded them, point to the increasing hardship and poverty they caused, attack them for reversing the 1952 land reform and other political achievements, and criticize their appropriateness for the way most households survive and make a living. What remains remarkably difficult, however, is to account for what was happening in the countryside in a way that not only questions the extent or desirability of the advance of market capitalism, but avoids telling it as the story of capitalism.
zh: 20世纪末描述第三世界农村的主导主题，仍然是其资本主义转变的故事。这一主题在埃及农村得到了体现：通过被称为结构调整的计划，改革和取消国家控制，意在把土地及其产物变为市场商品，并把乡村重造成21世纪的完全资本主义经济。批评这一资本主义推进故事有几种方式。就埃及而言，人们可以质疑某些市场改革实施得有多认真，追问人们以何种方式抵制或规避它们，指出它们造成的日益加剧的困苦和贫困，抨击它们逆转1952年土地改革及其他政治成就，批评它们不适合大多数家户生存和谋生的方式。然而，仍然极难做到的是，以一种不仅质疑市场资本主义推进的程度或可取性、而且避免把它讲成资本主义故事的方式来解释乡村正在发生的事情。

en: Let me return to the themes I introduced at the beginning of this book and recall why one might want to avoid telling capitalism’s story. The power of the market economy reveals itself not only in the transforming of people’s lives and livelihoods but in its influence over the way we think. It is one of those ideas that we seem able to grasp only in terms that the phenomenon itself dictates. There are many different ways to describe the nature of the market economy, yet every description carries a common assumption. It is variously said to be based upon principles of self-interest, profit making, the proper organization of pricing and other forms of information, the accumulation and reinvestment of capital, the separation of capital from the labor it exploits, and a continuous historical process of worldwide expansion and transformation. Different accounts may highlight or ignore different features from this list. But every attempt to describe the capitalist economy inevitably attempts to capture what distinguishes the market system from the nonmarket, or the capitalist mode of production from the noncapitalist. The distinction gives capitalism its identity.
zh: 让我回到本书开头提出的主题，回顾为什么人们可能想避免讲述资本主义的故事。市场经济的力量不仅体现在改变人们的生活和生计上，也体现在它对我们思维方式的影响上。它属于那种我们似乎只能以现象本身所规定的术语来把握的观念。描述市场经济性质的方式有很多，然而每一种描述都带有共同的假设。人们说它基于自利、营利、价格及其他形式信息的适当组织、资本的积累和再投资、资本同它所剥削的劳动的分离，以及一个持续的世界性扩张和转变的历史过程等原则。不同的叙述可能突出或忽略这份清单中的不同特征。但每一次描述资本主义经济的尝试，都不可避免地试图抓住使市场体系区别于非市场体系、或资本主义生产方式区别于非资本主义生产方式的东西。这一区分赋予资本主义以身份。

en: For capitalism to work as a structure of representation, that is, as a way of appearing to distribute phenomena in terms of a distinction between a real world and its meaning, it must have an identity. There must be some characteristic that is the essence of capitalism, some element of sameness, so that as it develops and expands one can recognize its occurrence through different material and temporal manifestations and hold together its story. One could call this the “homoficence” of capitalism: whatever the local variation, at some level capitalism always does the same thing, or has the same effect.

The sameness supplies the theme that enables the narrative to move forward. It provides a logic that becomes the source of historical movement and the motor of social transformations. In rural Egypt one can attribute the spread of free-market practices to the force of self-interest and individual economic freedom, once the restraints of state control and other noncapitalist arrangements are removed. Or, following a different conception of capitalism’s essence, one can ascribe the changes to the power of Egyptian and international capital, driven by the need to accumulate and reproduce. Whichever way one tells the story, what is happening in rural Egypt, or anywhere else in the rural Third World, receives its logic and meaning from the movement of the principle of market capitalism.
zh: 要使资本主义作为一种再现结构发挥作用，也就是说，作为一种以现实世界与其意义之间的区分来分配现象的显现方式，它必须有一种身份。必须有某种特征是资本主义的本质，某种同一性要素，这样，随着它的发展和扩张，人们可以通过不同的物质和时间表现识别它的出现，并保持其故事的连贯。人们可以称之为资本主义的“同效性”（homoficence）：无论地方差异如何，在某个层面上，资本主义总是做同样的事，或产生同样的效果。

这种同一性提供了使叙事得以推进的主题。它提供了一种逻辑，成为历史运动的来源和社会变迁的驱动。在埃及农村，一旦国家控制和其他非资本主义安排的束缚被解除，人们可以把自由市场实践的传播归因于自利和个人经济自由的力量。或者，按照对资本主义本质的另一种理解，可以把变化归因于埃及和国际资本的力量，其驱动力是积累和再生产的需要。无论以哪种方式讲述，埃及农村或第三世界任何其他地方正在发生的事情，都从市场资本主义原则的运动中获得其逻辑和意义。

en: This logic does not mean that there are no other factors at work. The narrative gives a place to all kinds of noncapitalist features. The countryside may contain what one thinks of as traditional practices or precapitalist social arrangements, which resist the spread of the market or even interact with it in some kind of transitional articulation. It may contain political forces that present obstacles to the spread of capitalism or corrupt its operation. People may have social values or cultural norms that differ from those of the market. What characterizes all these additional features, however, is that when they are placed within the larger story of capitalism they are determined by its logic. The narrative marks them as nonmarket factors, meaning that it defines their identity and significance in terms of what they are not. Their role is that of negative elements. They stand outside the principle of the market, as external, nondynamic, generally residual, mostly local factors. As the exterior of capitalism, moreover, although they may impede its progress or distort its path, they do not shape its essence. They play no part in defining its nature. The market economy is understood to be a universal form constituted only from its own internal logic. The local and residual features encountered in a place like rural Egypt do not affect its real nature.
zh: 这种逻辑并不意味着没有其他因素在起作用。叙事为各种非资本主义特征留有一席之地。乡村可能包含人们所设想的传统习俗或前资本主义社会安排，它们抵制市场的扩展，甚至以某种过渡性的接合方式与之互动。乡村可能包含给资本主义扩张造成障碍或腐蚀其运作的政治力量。人们可能拥有不同于市场的价值观念或文化规范。然而，所有这些额外特征的特点是，当它们被置于资本主义的更大故事中时，便由资本主义的逻辑所决定。叙事把它们标记为非市场因素，这意味着它以它们不是什么来界定其身份和意义。它们的角色是消极要素的角色。它们站在市场原则之外，是外部的、非动态的、通常是残余的、大多是地方性的因素。此外，作为资本主义的外部，尽管它们可能阻碍其进步或扭曲其道路，却不塑造其本质。它们在界定其性质方面不起作用。市场经济被理解为一种普遍形式，只由其自身的内在逻辑构成。在埃及农村之类地方遇到的本地和残余特征，并不影响其真正本质。

en: Since the capitalist economy is understood to be determined by its own inner logic, since it has an inside or essence that determines its nature, one thinks of it as its own sphere. It appears to be a self-contained space, distinct from other social spheres such as the household, the state, or the sphere of culture. During the past two centuries, the changing forms of capitalist economic discourse have defined this space in different ways. As I discussed in chapter 3, the classical political economists from the late eighteenth to the mid-nineteenth century did not refer to an object called the economy. Writers like David Ricardo described a regular motion of production, exchange, and consumption whose regularity derived from the natural cycle of the country’s major commodity, wheat, and whose movement they called the market. Later in the nineteenth century, Leon Walras and the new science of economics turned the market into a mathematical abstraction, while Marx replaced it with a much broader conception of material production and exchange. It was only in the 1930s and 1940s that the modern idea of the economy appeared, reflecting the collapse of a colonial organization of power, knowledge, and exchange, and the rise of the national state as producer of statistical knowledge and custodian of the economic. In the last quarter of the twentieth century these conceptions began to shift again. In Anglo-American political discourse the market came to stand for a system of forces that the state claimed was independent of its management of the economy, setting limits that this management could not profitably transgress.
zh: 既然资本主义经济被理解为由自身内在逻辑决定，既然它有一个决定其性质的内在或本质，人们就把它看作自己的领域。它似乎是一个自足的空间，与家户、国家或文化领域等其他社会领域不同。在过去的两个世纪里，资本主义经济话语不断变化的形式以不同方式界定了这一空间。正如我在第3章所讨论的，从18世纪末到19世纪中叶的古典政治经济学家并没有提到一个叫作经济的对象。大卫·李嘉图这样的作家描述了一种生产、交换和消费的有规则运动，其规律性来自该国主要商品小麦的自然周期，他们把这种运动称为市场。19世纪后期，莱昂·瓦尔拉斯和新兴的经济学把市场变成数学抽象，而马克思则代之以关于物质生产和交换的远为宽泛的概念。直到1930和1940年代，现代的经济观念才出现，反映了殖民主义的权力、知识和交换组织的崩溃，以及作为统计知识生产者和经济守护者的民族国家的兴起。在20世纪最后四分之一，这些观念再次开始转变。在英美政治话语中，市场逐渐代表一种力量体系，国家声称该体系独立于自己对经济的管理，并为这种管理设定了不能有利逾越的界限。

en: The idea that market capitalism has a unitary and universal nature that is not determined by the local or nonmarket elements it encounters rests, therefore, not only on simple distinctions between capitalist and noncapitalist or market and nonmarket. These distinctions are part of more complex fields of practice that have established the measures, exclusions, and power relations that make possible the market or the economy as forms of technical and material organization. Academic disciplines, state institutions, international development organizations, and bodies of statistical and theoretical knowledge have all played roles in this process. The ideas of the economy and the market seem so matter-of-fact that they would appear as central categories in almost any discussion of the changes transforming the rural Third World. Yet when they are taken for granted they conceal more than they reveal. A study of contemporary rural Egypt that assumes the economy to be a universal and unproblematic object would overlook the political process of its creation, as well as the local history of this process in Egyptian politics that I outlined in chapter 3. What is more important, it would reproduce the assumption that the economy is its own freestanding sphere, determined by its own logic, and that the obstacles and resistances to the market economy encountered in the countryside must be grasped only as the subsidiary, reactive, and local responses to the universal story of capitalism.
zh: 因此，认为市场资本主义具有单一而普遍的本质、且不受其遇到的本地或非市场因素决定的想法，不仅建立在资本主义与非资本主义、市场与非市场之间的简单区分上。这些区分是更复杂的实践领域的一部分；这些实践确立了使市场或经济成为技术和物质组织形式成为可能的度量、排除和权力关系。学术学科、国家机构、国际发展组织以及统计和理论知识体系都在这一过程中发挥了作用。经济和市场的观念看起来如此理所当然，以至于在几乎所有讨论第三世界农村变迁的论述中，它们似乎都应成为核心范畴。然而当人们把它们视为理所当然时，它们所遮蔽的比揭示的更多。一项假定经济是一个普遍且不成问题的对象的当代埃及农村研究，会忽视其创造的政治过程，以及我在第3章概述的这一过程在埃及政治中的地方历史。更重要的是，它会复制这样的假设：经济是自身独立的领域，由自身逻辑决定，而乡村中所遇到的对市场经济的障碍和抵抗，只能被理解为对资本主义普遍故事之附属、反应性和地方性的回应。

en: There have been only a couple of studies of the ways in which villagers in Egypt relate to what we call the market, with many accounts treating the village in isolation. These studies describe the complexity of the social organization of marketing, which for any one village involves several different kinds of merchants and agents, numerous levels of trade ranging from the centralized to the very local, a variety of financial arrangements, and many alternative sites of exchange. They also stress the importance farmers attach to their personal relationship with merchants, because of the mutual trust on which exchanges often depend.

Such analyses provide an excellent corrective to the image of the market one finds among proponents of free-market reforms, which typically begin from an abstract model of exchange and mention what actually occurs, if at all, only as the failure of or deviation from this abstraction. They insist, however, that these complex local practices represent a certain level of development of “the market” in general, and that farmers are best understood as small capitalists. Even when farmers engage in an apparently nonmarket practice, such as growing food for their own consumption, they are calculating that this is a better use of resources than marketing their crops and purchasing food. They are therefore dealing with the market.
zh: 关于埃及村民如何与我们所谓的市场发生关系，只有少数几项研究，许多叙述把村庄当作孤立单位来对待。这些研究描述了市场销售之社会组织的复杂性：对任何一个村庄来说，这涉及几种不同类型的商人和代理人、从集中化到非常地方性的众多贸易层级、各种金融安排，以及许多替代性交换场所。它们还强调农民重视与商人的个人关系，因为交换常常依赖相互信任。

这类分析为自由市场改革支持者心目中的市场形象提供了极好的矫正。后者的市场形象通常始于一个抽象的交换模型，只在可能的情况下提及实际发生的事情，而且只作为这一抽象的失败或偏离。然而这些研究坚持，这些复杂的地方实践代表了“市场”总体上的某种发展水平，最好把农民理解为小资本家。即使农民从事表面上的非市场实践，比如为自己消费而种植粮食，他们也是在盘算这比出售作物再购买粮食是更好的资源利用方式。因此他们是在与市场打交道。

en: If one must decide whether small farmers are capitalist or noncapitalist, then capitalist seems the correct choice. It avoids attributing apparently nonmarket relations either to tradition and ignorance, as free-market reformers often do, or to a parallel mode of production, oriented toward subsistence, that somehow coexists amid all these complex involvements with a market system. Yet the effect of describing these local social forms as a variety of market capitalism is to reproduce the general narrative of capitalism. However complex the local variations, they must derive from some internal principle of capitalism—a principle so abstract it has no location, and is therefore assumed to be universal or global.
zh: 如果必须判断小农是资本主义还是非资本主义，那么资本主义似乎是正确的选择。这样可以避免像自由市场改革者那样把表面上的非市场关系归因于传统和无知，也避免把它归因于一种平行的、以生计为导向的生产方式——不知何故与市场体系的这些复杂卷入并存。然而，把这些地方社会形式描述为一种市场资本主义，其效果是复制资本主义的一般叙事。无论地方变体多么复杂，它们都必须源自资本主义的某种内在原则——这一原则如此抽象，以致没有位置，因此被假定为普遍的或全球的。

en: Another important way of addressing the variety of relations to the market has been to introduce the idea of “multiple capitalisms,” or, more broadly, of “alternative modernities.” Such an approach might emphasize the variety of local, regional, and global forces whose combination shapes the particular histories of capitalist globalization, producing different versions in different places. These formulations provide a less Eurocentric way of acknowledging the importance and variation of the non-European contexts of capitalism’s development and can reveal the complex and multiple origins of what we too easily unify under the name of globalization. Yet the strength of this sort of approach also contains a weakness. On the one hand, the language of alternative modernities can suggest an almost infinite play of possibilities, with no rigorous sense of what, if anything, gives capitalist globalization what seems its phenomenal power of replication and expansion. On the other hand, the vocabulary of alternatives still implies a fundamentally singular capitalism underneath, modified by local circumstances into alternative forms. It is only in reference to this implied generic that such alternatives can be imagined and discussed.
zh: 另一种处理各种市场关系的重要方式，是引入“多元资本主义”或更宽泛的“另类现代性”观念。这种方法可能强调地方、区域和全球力量的各种组合，这些力量的结合塑造了资本主义全球化的特定历史，在不同地方产生不同的版本。这些表述提供了一种较少欧洲中心主义的方式来承认资本主义发展之非欧洲背景的重要性和多样性，并能揭示我们过于轻易地归在全球化名下的东西那复杂而多样的起源。然而，这类方法的优势也包含着弱点。一方面，另类现代性的语言可能暗示几乎无限的可能性游戏，却没有严格说明究竟是什么（如果有的话）赋予了资本主义全球化那种看似非凡的复制和扩张力量。另一方面，另类的词汇仍然暗示着底层一种根本单一的资本主义，它被地方环境修改为另类的形式。只有参照这个隐含的通用概念，才能想象和讨论这些另类。

en: Is there another way to make sense of what is happening in places like the Egyptian countryside? Can one find a way to take this local complexity and variation and make it challenge the narrative of the market? Can one do so without positing the existence of a precapitalist or noncapitalist sphere, or even multiple capitalisms, positions that always reinvoke the universal nature of capitalism? To begin to do so, we have to stop asking whether rural Egypt is capitalist or not. We have to avoid the assumption that capitalism has an “is” and take more seriously the variations, disruptions, and dislocations that make each appearance of capitalism, despite the plans of the reformers, something different.
zh: 有没有另一种方式理解埃及农村之类地方正在发生的事情？能否找到一种方式，把握这种地方的复杂性和多样性，并使之挑战市场的叙事？能否在不预设前资本主义或非资本主义领域、甚至不预设多元资本主义的情况下做到这一点——这些立场总是重新唤起资本主义的普遍本质？要开始这样做，我们必须不再问埃及农村是不是资本主义。我们必须避免假设资本主义有一个“是”，而更认真地对待那些使资本主义的每一次出现——尽管改革者有种种计划——都成为不同事物的变异、中断和错位。

en: I propose to explore these questions by drawing on the experience of a rural community in southern Egypt in the 1990s.
There are several aspects of the village’s experience I will discuss, but to give a focus to the account I want to look in particular at the question of wheat.
zh: 我打算借助1990年代埃及南部一个农村共同体的经验来探讨这些问题。
我将讨论该村经验的几个方面，但为了给叙述一个焦点，我想特别考察小麦问题。

en: Wheat provides an appropriate theme for a critique of economic discourse. The classical political economists, as I mentioned in chapter 3, based their picture of the market as a natural process on the production cycle of wheat. Indeed David Ricardo wrote his seminal essay in political economy, the “Essay on Profits” of 1815, as part of a political debate about protecting the price of wheat.

A century later, between 1873 and 1935, the global expansion of the colonial powers coincided with large increases in the production of wheat and new ways of transporting it. Wheat became the first major commodity to develop a world market, with producers everywhere facing a single price.

Toward the end of the twentieth century wheat acquired a different significance, symbolizing a popular resistance to the global market. In Egypt and Jordan and beyond the Arab world efforts to end national protection against the world market were marked by major riots protesting the increase in the price of bread. On January 18, 1977, when the Egyptian government announced it was accepting the demand of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) to eliminate food subsidies and doubling the price of bread, groups of workers, students, and the urban poor marched to the center of Cairo in protest. The demonstrations turned to riots and spread to Alexandria and nineteen smaller cities, where shops, government buildings, and police stations were attacked. The government brought the army into the streets to quell the protests by force but was able to restore order only two days later, when it rescinded the price increases. The government claimed that 77 people had died and 214 were wounded, but unofficial estimates were several times higher.
Two decades later, no discussion of the IMF reforms in Egypt could pass without reference to the bread riots of January 1977.
zh: 小麦为批判经济话语提供了一个合适的主题。正如我在第3章提到的，古典政治经济学家把市场描绘为自然过程，依据的是小麦的生产周期。事实上，大卫·李嘉图1815年撰写其政治经济学开创性论文《论利润》时，正是围绕保护小麦价格的辩论的一部分。
一个世纪后，1873年至1935年间，殖民列强的全球扩张恰逢小麦产量大幅增加及其运输的新方式。小麦成为第一种发展出世界市场的主要商品，各地生产者面对单一价格。

到20世纪末，小麦获得了不同的意义，象征着对全球市场的民众抵抗。在埃及、约旦和阿拉伯世界之外，结束国家对世界市场保护的种种努力，都以抗议面包价格上涨的大规模骚乱为标志。1977年1月18日，当埃及政府宣布接受国际货币基金组织（IMF）取消食品补贴的要求并将面包价格翻倍时，成群工人、学生和城市贫民游行到开罗市中心抗议。示威演变为骚乱，蔓延到亚历山大和十九个较小城市，商店、政府建筑和警察局遭到袭击。政府把军队开上街头以武力镇压抗议，但两天后才在取消涨价后恢复秩序。政府声称77人死亡、214人受伤，但非官方估计高出数倍。
二十年后，任何关于埃及国际货币基金组织改革的讨论都绕不开1977年1月的面包骚乱。

en: Following this confrontation, as all the accounts of the Egyptian economic reforms relate, the government moved more slowly and surreptitiously toward the reintroduction of world market prices for wheat. Protection had begun in 1941 as a measure to counteract the food shortages and price inflation caused by the war and the associated fertilizer crisis, discussed in chapter 1. In 1966 the government introduced ration cards to control distribution after the United States cut off its supply of subsidized wheat. When nonmarket U.S. wheat returned in large amounts following Egypt’s realignment with Washington in 1974, the ration system changed from a form of quantity control into a method of distributing almost unlimited supplies of highly subsidized bread.

From the mid-1980s, as the United States began to demand market prices for the wheat it had previously dumped (with the express aim of creating a future market), the Ministry of Supply started to increase the price and reduce the availability and quality of subsidized bread and flour. It also stopped issuing ration cards for children born after 1991. At the same time the Ministry of Agriculture began to introduce policies demanded by the United States to create an uncontrolled domestic market. The ministry claimed to have ended government control of all crop areas, quotas, and prices by 1987, except for rice, cotton, and sugarcane, and for all except sugarcane by 1992. The government also relaxed its control of marketing and processing. In the case of wheat, it reduced its share of domestic production to about 50 percent after 1992, and also allowed private companies to begin importing wheat flour.
zh: 这次对抗之后，正如所有关于埃及经济改革的叙述所述，政府更加缓慢和隐蔽地走向重新引入小麦的世界市场价格。保护措施始于1941年，作为应对战争引起的粮食短缺和价格通胀及相关化肥危机的举措，第1章已讨论过。1966年，在美国切断补贴小麦供应后，政府引入配给卡以控制分配。1974年埃及与华盛顿重新结盟后，当非市场的美国小麦大量回流时，配给制度从一种数量控制形式变成了分发几乎无限量的高补贴面包的方法。

从1980年代中期起，随着美国开始要求对其先前倾销的小麦按市场价格付费（其明确目的是创造未来市场），供应部开始提高价格，减少补贴面包和面粉的供应并降低质量。它还停止为1991年后出生的儿童发放配给卡。与此同时，农业部开始引入美国要求的政策，以创造不受控制的国内市场。该部声称到1987年已结束政府对除稻米、棉花和甘蔗以外所有作物面积、配额和价格的控制，到1992年除甘蔗外全部结束。政府还放松了对销售和加工的控制。就小麦而言，1992年后它把在国内产量中所占份额降至约50%，还允许私营公司开始进口小麦面粉。

en: What was the experience of these changes in rural Egypt? The village from which I want to draw some observations is located in a sugarcaneproducing region of Qina governorate. It lies about six kilometers from the town of Luxor on the other side of the Nile and on the periphery of its tourist industry.
Bread is the village’s staple food, but in the 1990s it had no bakeries and almost none of its more than two thousand households bought bread already baked.

Instead they used wheat flour to make the large sourdough loaves known as ʿaish shamshi, leavened in the sun and baked in earthen ovens at home. The dozen or so largest landowners used only wheat from their own fields, but the rest depended in part or whole on sacks of purchased flour. As the government-subsidized domestic flour was made scarcer, more expensive, and of the worst quality, all except the poorest households came to depend increasingly on highly refined, mostly imported white flour purchased from local merchants at unregulated prices.
zh: 这些变化在埃及农村的经验如何？我想从中得出一些观察的村庄位于基纳省一个甘蔗产区。它距离尼罗河对岸的卢克索镇约六公里，位于其旅游业的边缘。
面包是村民的主食，但在1990年代，村里没有面包房，其两千多户人家中几乎没有人买烤好的面包。
相反，他们用小磨面粉制作被称为ʿaish shamshi的大块酸面饼，在阳光下发酵，在家中的土炉里烘烤。十来户最大的土地所有者只用自家地里的小麦，其余人则部分或完全依赖购买的面粉袋。随着政府补贴的国产面粉变得更加稀缺、昂贵、质量最差，除最贫困的家户外，所有家户都越来越依赖从当地商人以不受管制价格购买的高度精制、大多为进口的白面粉。

en: Many households with small landholdings dealt with these changes by growing increasing amounts of their own wheat, which they processed at one of the tiny, one-room village mills and used entirely for household bread making. Zaynab, for example, who owned twenty qirats (five-sixths of an acre) and used to produce little or no wheat, now grew it on more than half her land.

With eight children but no grown men to feed (her husband worked eleven months out of twelve at a poultry factory outside Alexandria), a strong yield would supply all her needs for the year. The Mahmud household farmed four acres and now used more than half the land for wheat, although with three married sons and their wives and children the crop would not quite supply their needs. Rather than run out of homegrown wheat, which makes bread of superior texture and taste, the women added a little white flour each time they baked. The village’s largest landowner, Salim, who controlled more than 300 of its 2,750 acres, produced an enormous surplus of wheat, which he sold to grain merchants from Qina or other large towns. Unlike the smallholders, however, he had not increased his wheat acreage since the deregulation of the market, preferring (for reasons to be explored) to keep most of his land in sugarcane.
zh: 许多拥有小块土地的家户通过种植更多自家小麦来应对这些变化；他们在村里一间很小的单间磨坊加工，全部用于家庭烤面包。例如，扎伊纳布拥有二十基拉特（六分之五费丹）土地，过去几乎不产小麦，现在她一半以上的地种上了小麦。

她有八个孩子，但没有成年男子要养活（她丈夫一年十二个月中有十一个月在亚历山大郊外一家家禽厂工作），好收成能供她全年所需。马哈茂德家耕种四费丹，现在一半以上的地种小麦，尽管有三个已婚儿子及其妻儿，收成仍不够满足需求。为了不耗尽自家种的小麦——它做的面包质地和味道更好——妇女们每次烤面包都加一点白面粉。村里最大的土地所有者萨利姆控制着2,750费丹中的300多费丹，生产大量小麦剩余，卖给基纳或其他大镇的粮商。然而，与小农不同，自市场放开以来，他没有增加小麦种植面积，宁愿（原因有待探讨）把大部分土地留在甘蔗上。

en: The Ministry of Agriculture produced statistics that reflected the increased production of wheat, at least among smallholders, and may have exaggerated it. The official figures for the country as a whole report that levels of wheat production stagnated at just under two million metric tons a year from the early 1970s until 1986, then suddenly doubled to more than four million tons by 1990 and increased to more than six million by 1998. The biggest percentage increase came in 1987, immediately following the removal of area restrictions, quotas, and fixed procurement prices, when production jumped by 40 percent in one year (see fig. 5). The ministry, the IMF, and the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) regularly cited these figures as the best proof of the success of their program of free-market reforms.
zh: 农业部编制的统计反映了小麦产量的增加——至少在小农中如此——而且可能夸大了这一增加。全国官方数字报告说，从1970年代初到1986年，小麦产量停滞在略低于每年200万公吨，随后到1990年突然翻倍至400万吨以上，到1998年增至600万吨以上。最大的百分比增长出现在1987年，即取消面积限制、配额和固定收购价格之后，当年产量跃升40%（见图5）。农业部、国际货币基金组织和美国国际开发署（USAID）经常引用这些数字，作为其自由市场改革计划成功的最佳证据。

en: While acknowledging that there was a significant increase in wheat production, one can point to two problems with this use of such figures. First, the system of compulsory cropping and low procurement prices in place before the 1987 reform, which particularly affected small farmers, gave them a strong incentive to disguise the size of their wheat yields. (The method of gathering agricultural statistics offered several opportunities for doing so. The census staff determined the area planted with a given crop in each village, “with the help of village administrative staff,” simply by asking farmers what they had planted. They took field measurements for cotton, wheat, rice, and cane, measuring only half of each crop, and taking measurements only along the sides of existing survey parcels. They determined yields by asking the farmers again, and by eye estimates. Sample field measurements were made only in two villages in each district.)

Smallholders who were required to grow a quota of sugarcane or other commercial crops and sell them to the government at low prices also had good reason to divert part of their land to crops they could eat themselves, including wheat. At the very least they would ensure that any particularly poor soil was allocated to government crops, not those consumed at home. (“There’s the government’s sesame,” ʿAmm Mahmud used to say, pointing to a barren patch of whitish soil that never produced anything.) These sorts of practices may well have increased during the 1980s, as procurement prices dropped in real terms,
zh: 尽管承认小麦产量有显著增加，人们可以指出这样使用数字有两个问题。首先，1987年改革前实行的强制种植和低收购价格制度对小农影响尤大，使他们有强烈动机隐瞒小麦产量。（收集农业统计的方法提供了若干这样做机会。普查人员“在村行政人员帮助下”，仅通过询问农民种了什么来确定每个村庄某一作物的种植面积。他们对棉花、小麦、水稻和甘蔗进行实地测量，只测量每种作物的一半，并且只沿现有调查地块的边缘测量。他们通过再次询问农民和目测估计来确定产量。每个区只在两个村庄进行抽样实地测量。）
被要求种植一定配额甘蔗或其他经济作物并以低价卖给政府的小农，也有充分理由把部分土地转种可自家食用的作物，包括小麦。至少他们会确保把任何特别贫瘠的土壤分配给政府作物，而不是自家食用的作物。（“那是政府的芝麻地，”阿姆·马哈茂德过去常指着一块从不长出任何东西的发白贫瘠地块说。）这类做法在1980年代很可能增加了，因为收购价格实际价值下降，

en: subsidized flour became harder to obtain, and consumer prices for other foods increased sharply. The stagnant yields of the years before 1987, which according to the official view made necessary the shift to an unregulated market, may in fact reflect, in whole or in part, the smallholders’ unreported diversion of land and crops to better serve their own needs.

To the extent that this is the case, something one has no way of measuring, the impact of the free-market reforms may have been more on the statistics published by the state than on what farmers were actually growing.
zh: 补贴面粉越来越难获得，其他食品的消费价格急剧上涨。1987年前那些年头产量停滞——官方观点认为这种停滞使转向不受管制的市场成为必要——事实上可能全部或部分反映了小农未报告的将土地和作物转用于更好满足自身需求的做法。
如果情况如此——人们无法衡量这一点——自由市场改革的影响可能更多体现在国家公布的统计上，而不是农民实际种植的东西上。

en: Second, it is curious that those telling the story of Egyptian agriculture at the end of the twentieth century as one of successful movement toward a free market should produce as the best evidence of its progress the fact that farmers were moving not toward the market but toward increased self-provisioning and protection from the market.

The rationale for the deregulation of agriculture was that farmers would respond by growing more so-called high value crops, especially export crops such as cotton and vegetables, drawing themselves more fully into the national and transnational market economy and thereby increasing their own and the nation’s income. This did not happen. In the six years following the 1987 deregulation the area planted with cotton, the two main vegetable crops (tomatoes and potatoes), and most other vegetables declined.

The value of agricultural exports fell sharply, and even a decade after deregulation had not yet recovered to prereform levels (see fig. 6). The area planted with grain and fodder crops serving mostly household production, on the other hand, remained steady, and in the case of two staple grains, wheat and rice, dramatically increased.

In the northern Delta, where rice replaces bread as the staple food, farmers planted so much of the crop that the government issued 250,000 fines and threatened farmers with imprisonment in an attempt to conserve water supplies for industrial and export crops.
Altogether, crops intended mostly for the farm household accounted for more than two-thirds of the crop area following the reforms.
zh: 其次，奇怪的是，那些把20世纪末埃及农业说成成功走向自由市场的人，竟然把农民并非走向市场、而是走向更多自给自足和避开市场这一事实，当作其进步的最佳证据。
农业放开的理由，是农民会通过种植更多所谓高价值作物来回应，尤其是棉花和蔬菜等出口作物，从而更充分地进入全国和跨国市场经济，进而增加自己和国家的收入。这并没有发生。1987年放开后的六年里，棉花、两种主要蔬菜作物（番茄和马铃薯）以及大多数其他蔬菜的种植面积都下降了。
农业出口值急剧下降，甚至放开十年后仍未恢复到改革前水平（见图6）。另一方面，供家户生产之用的谷物和饲料作物种植面积保持稳定，而小麦和水稻这两种主粮的种植面积则急剧增加。
在尼罗河三角洲北部，稻米取代面包成为主食，农民种植了太多水稻，政府开出25万张罚单并以监禁威胁农民，试图为工业和出口作物节约用水。
总而言之，改革后供农场家户自用为主的作物占作物面积的三分之二以上。

en: In the village itself several smallholders reported experimenting with growing vegetables for the market after the government controls were lifted, with mixed results. In 1988 Ahmad Hassan planted two qirats of aubergines and sold the crop for E£700, a good return.

The following year he planted six qirats, or a quarter of an acre, which was half his landholding. There was a shortage of irrigation water one month, the crop dried out, and his entire yield filled barely three baskets. He sold the crop for E£20. Others reported planting tomatoes and getting E£2 or E£3 per kilo, selling directly to a man with a truck who shipped them to the Rod al-Farag wholesale market in Cairo. Then came “ayyam Saddam,” the 1990–91 Gulf crisis, when tourism collapsed and with it the price of vegetables. People were selling two or three kilos for just fifty piastres. Others told different disaster stories, while many more were unable even to consider taking such risks.
zh: 在村里，有几个小农报告说，政府控制取消后，他们尝试种植蔬菜供市场销售，结果好坏参半。1988年，艾哈迈德·哈桑种了两基拉特的茄子，卖了700埃镑，回报不错。

第二年，他种了六基拉特，即四分之一费丹，是他土地的一半。有一个月灌溉水短缺，作物干枯，全部收成勉强装了三筐。他卖了20埃镑。其他人报告说种了番茄，每公斤卖2或3埃镑，直接卖给一个开卡车的人，后者把它们运往开罗的罗德法拉杰批发市场。接着是“萨达姆的日子”，即1990—91年海湾危机，旅游业崩溃，蔬菜价格也随之崩溃。人们两三公斤只卖50皮阿斯特。其他人讲述了不同的灾难故事，而更多的人甚至无法考虑承担这样的风险。

en: Instead farmers adopted other strategies to increase their income, but these often took them in different directions than the market. To prepare one of her strips of land for planting the 1996/97 crop of wheat, to begin with a simple example, Zaynab hired a distant cousin who used a wooden plough, drawn by a cow and its calf. During the eight years since she started farming her own land she had always hired tractors. By the end of the 1980s these had almost entirely replaced animal-drawn ploughs, a process encouraged by government subsidies and USAID programs to promote the importation of agricultural machinery.

The ending of subsidies, however, had removed some of the cost advantage of the tractor (E£1.50 to E£2 for a tractor to plough one qirat, compared to E£2.50 for the cow). Zaynab had also learned that animal-drawn ploughs produce a better yield, because they do not compact the soil as tractors do, especially when making tight turns at the ends of the narrow, elongated strips that small farmers own. Moreover, she talked the owners of neighboring plots into hiring the same plough and received a discount in return that made it cheaper
zh: 相反，农民采取了其他策略增加收入，但这些策略常常把他们引向与市场不同的方向。举个简单的例子，为了准备一块地种植1996/97年小麦，扎伊纳布雇了一个远房表亲，用一头奶牛及其小牛拉的木犁。她开始自己种地以来的八年里，一直雇拖拉机。到1980年代末，拖拉机几乎完全取代了畜力犁，这一过程得到政府补贴和美国国际开发署促进农业机械进口项目的鼓励。
然而，补贴的终止消除了拖拉机的一部分成本优势（拖拉机犁一基拉特要1.50至2埃镑，而牛要2.50埃镑）。扎伊纳布还了解到，畜力犁产量更高，因为它们不像拖拉机那样压紧土壤，尤其是在小农所拥有的狭长地块两端急转弯时。此外，她说服邻近地块的所有主雇用同一张犁，得到了折扣，使成本比拖拉机更低，
