en: than the tractor. (It helped that the plough was owned by a relative.) The owner was now in such demand that he hired a partner to do the ploughing, in return for one-third of the income. Machines have a limited life and their owners must pay for their replacement. The cow trains its own calf as it ploughs, and in two or three years the calf can take its place. Fueled with homegrown fodder and producing its own replacement, the cow represented another part of people’s engagement in logics that moved away from or at cross-purposes with the logic of the market.
zh: （犁属于一位亲戚，这也有帮助。）犁的主人现在供不应求，雇了一个伙伴来犁地，回报是收入的三分之一。机器寿命有限，主人必须支付更换费用。牛在犁地时训练自己的小牛，两三年后小牛就能顶替它。以自家种的饲料为燃料，还能自我替代，牛代表了人们参与另一些逻辑的又一个部分——这些逻辑远离市场逻辑，或与之相左。

en: These alternative strategies do not create a separate sphere of practice that might be labeled traditional or nonmarket and contrasted to the market sphere. On a strip of land in a different part of the village, also prepared for wheat, Zaynab hired a tractor to plough. The tractor’s owner, Abu Qumsan, farmed an adjacent strip and Zaynab depended on his son, who drove the tractor, for other favors during the year. The father owned only three acres, far less than any other tractor owner, so he was particularly dependent on renting out the tractor to work his neighbors’ plots. Zaynab decided it would be prudent to maintain good relations with him by continuing to hire his tractor. Elsewhere in the village, to give a different example, farmers had begun to reintroduce the use of camels, particularly to carry the sugarcane crop. Like the animal plough, camels had been almost completely replaced by tractors over the previous decade. But then a number of young men from different hamlets in the village began to invest in camels. They used them to carry sugarcane in the mornings, then decked them with saddles and decorated cloths and took them to the ferry where tourists disembarked from Luxor to earn money offering rides through the village.
zh: 这些替代策略并没有创造出一个可以标记为传统的或非市场的、并与市场领域相对立的独立实践领域。在村庄另一部分的一块地上，也准备种小麦，扎伊纳布雇了拖拉机来犁。拖拉机的主人阿布·库姆桑耕种相邻的一块地，扎伊纳布一年中其他事情也得靠他开拖拉机的儿子帮忙。父亲只有三费丹地，远少于任何其他拖拉机主，因此他特别依赖出租拖拉机为邻居耕地。扎伊纳布决定，继续雇他的拖拉机以维持良好关系是明智的。再举一个不同的例子，村里其他地方，农民开始重新使用骆驼，尤其是运甘蔗。与畜力犁一样，过去十年间骆驼几乎完全被拖拉机取代。但后来，村里不同小村的许多年轻人开始投资骆驼。他们早上用骆驼运甘蔗，然后给骆驼配上鞍子和装饰布，带到游客从卢克索下船搭乘的渡口，靠载人游村赚钱。

en: Sugarcane offers a more complex case of this imbrication, an example of the difficulty of distinguishing between market and nonmarket practices. The Mahmud household, with four acres and three married sons, while increasing their wheat crop to more than two acres, still kept one acre devoted to the year-round production of sugarcane. This was their only cash crop. The rest of the land grew maize and berseem (Egyptian clover) to feed the animals and onions, mulukhiyya (a soup green), and other small crops to feed the household. The cane provided the income to purchase seeds, diesel for the irrigation pump, and fertilizer they required for growing household crops. The acre of cane would earn between E£4,500 and E£5,000 from the government sugar factory. The factory paid part of this amount in advance, providing a cash loan early in the year on which the household now depended. This was a further reason why they kept the sugarcane—as a source of credit. If they switched to another crop they could not survive the growing season without the loan. They were involved in production for the market, but its purpose was to support the much larger system of self-provisioning. This was true for the village as a whole, and probably for the entire country. The pattern is the reverse of that described in the old debates on the articulation of modes of production, and far more complex. Rather than a subsistence sector surviving in support of capitalism, market crops, protected and promoted by the state, survived in support of self-provisioning.
zh: 甘蔗提供了这种交织的更复杂案例，一个难以区分市场与非市场实践的例子。马哈茂德家有四费丹地和三个已婚儿子，虽然把小麦作物扩大到两费丹以上，仍保留一费丹专门全年种植甘蔗。这是他们唯一的经济作物。其余土地种玉米和亚历山大车轴草（埃及三叶草）喂养牲口，种洋葱、锦葵（一种汤菜）和其他小作物供家户食用。甘蔗提供收入，用于购买种子、灌溉泵用的柴油和种植自家作物所需的肥料。这一费丹甘蔗能从政府糖厂赚到4,500至5,000埃镑。糖厂预付其中一部分，在年初提供一笔现金贷款，家户现在依赖这笔贷款。这是他们保留甘蔗的又一个原因——作为信贷来源。如果改种其他作物，没有这笔贷款他们就无法度过生长季。他们参与了面向市场的生产，但其目的是支持规模大得多的自给自足体系。这对整个村庄如此，对整个国家可能也是如此。这一格局与旧的生产方式接合辩论所描述的相反，而且复杂得多。不是生存部门存续下来支持资本主义，而是由国家保护和促进的市场作物存续下来支持自给自足。

en: Small and medium-sized farmers like the Mahmud household had no interest in extending the production of a market crop such as sugarcane beyond the needs of their household production precisely because of the expense and loss involved in getting it to the market.

They cut and stripped the cane themselves with the help of neighbors and relatives, but had to hire a tractor and cart to carry it across the village to the light railway line running to the mill in Armant, fifteen kilometers to the south, and had to hire a pair of men to load the railway wagons. For an acre of cane the tractor cost E£500, the loaders E£300. As Rajab Mahmud said, “the tractor takes our profit.” The mill workers took some too, he swore, for when they weighed the cane at the factory they always cheated and recorded a lower weight for each farmer’s wagons. Household crops, on the other hand, which they also cut themselves, were carried to the house on a donkey cart or by hand, or in a pickup truck rented for a few pounds if the field was farther away. No one else took their profit.
zh: 像马哈茂德家这样的中小农对把甘蔗这类市场作物的生产扩大到超过家户生产需要毫无兴趣，恰恰是因为将其运往市场的费用和损失。

他们自己和邻居亲戚一起砍蔗剥叶，但必须雇一台拖拉机和拖车，把甘蔗运过村庄到通往南边十五公里处阿尔曼特糖厂的窄轨铁路，还得雇两个人装载铁路货车。一费丹甘蔗拖拉机要500埃镑，装卸工300埃镑。正如拉贾卜·马哈茂德所说，“拖拉机拿走了我们的利润。”他发誓说，糖厂工人也拿走了一些，因为他们在工厂称甘蔗时总是作弊，记下每个农民货车更低的重量。另一方面，家户作物也是他们自己收割，用驴车或人力运回家，如果地较远就租一辆皮卡，花几镑钱。没有别人拿走他们的利润。

en: These same considerations produced a different logic for the handful of very large landowners, for whom sugarcane had comparatively low labor costs. Salim, for example, who grew more than a hundred acres of cane, hired teams of day laborers at E£5 each per day (in 1996/97) for the planting, weeding, and harvesting of all his crops. His sons and nephews helped to supervise the laborers working in different areas of the village, and he employed a handful of permanent workers to drive the tractors he owned and operate his irrigation pumps and other machinery. Since all his crops carried the cost of hired labor, sugarcane was no more expensive to grow than wheat, maize, or broad beans. In fact, its labor costs were much lower. The cane stayed in the ground for three to five years, reducing the cost of planting, and needed fertilizing only three times a year. Salim’s crop was so large that its harvesting took five months, from late December until May. He employed wagon loaders continuously through this period, at a discount. He paid them only E£2 per ton of loaded cane, compared to the E£2.50 or E£3 that smallholders paid to hire loaders by the day, making his labor costs as much as 50 percent lower. Most important, villagers did much of his harvesting for free. Those with little or no land used the leaves of the cane, known as gilwah, as fodder for the household water buffalo. Mona, for example, who owned only a few qirats and rented several more to grow berseem, depended on the gilwah as an additional source of fodder. She helped harvest in the plots adjacent to her house and sent her sons to the plots on the far side of the same field. They did the difficult and physically dangerous work of cutting the cane and stripping its razor-sharp leaves without payment, or for a token amount, in exchange for taking the leaves, which had no market value. The interaction of paid and unpaid labor determined that the same crop that small farmers found the most costly to produce was for large landowners the cheapest. But the profits that led large owners to grow sugarcane rather than wheat depended upon a large supply of villagers with little or no land willing to do the most arduous work of all without payment.
zh: 同样的考虑为少数极大土地所有者产生了不同的逻辑：对他们来说，甘蔗的劳动成本相对较低。例如，萨利姆种了一百多费丹甘蔗，雇成队的日工（1996/97年）每人每天5埃镑，为他所有作物除草、种植和收割。他的儿子和侄子帮助监督在村里不同地区干活的工人，他还雇了几个长期工来开他拥有的拖拉机、操作灌溉泵和其他机械。由于他所有作物都承担雇工成本，甘蔗种起来并不比小麦、玉米或蚕豆更贵。事实上，它的劳动成本低得多。甘蔗在地里长三到五年，降低了种植成本，而且每年只需施三次肥。萨利姆的作物太多，收割要五个月，从12月下旬到5月。这期间他连续雇用装车工，而且有折扣。他只为每吨装车的甘蔗付2埃镑，相比之下小农按日雇装卸工要付2.50或3埃镑，使他的劳动成本低了多达50%。最重要的是，村民免费为他做了大部分收割工作。那些只有很少土地或没有土地的人，把甘蔗叶（gilwah）用作家里水牛的饲料。例如，蒙娜只有几基拉特地，又租了几基拉特种车轴草，依赖 gilwah 作为额外饲料来源。她帮助收割自家旁边地块的甘蔗，派儿子去同一块地另一边的地块。他们做砍甘蔗、剥开锋利如刀叶子的艰苦且对身体危险的工作，没有报酬，或只拿象征性的一点，以换取那些没有市场价值的叶子。有酬和无酬劳动的交织决定了：小农觉得生产成本最高的同一种作物，对大地主来说却是最便宜的。但促使大地主种甘蔗而非小麦的利润，依赖于大量少地或无地的村民愿意无偿做最艰苦的工作。

en: I have been calling sugarcane a market crop, but this is misleading. The mill that bought the crop was owned by the government, which fixed the purchase price. Yet this is not the misleading part. If the government were to have privatized the Egyptian Sugar and Refining Company, the farmers would still have had little choice over to whom to sell their crop or at what price. The company owned the narrow-gauge railway, and there was no other easy way to transport the cane. Once it is cut the cane’s moisture content and the sucrose proportion of the moisture rapidly decline, so it must reach the mill within hours. The crop takes eighteen months to grow when first planted and stays in the ground for at least two further ninemonth cultivations, so farmers had no way to respond to the ups and downs of international sugar prices.
zh: 我一直把甘蔗称为市场作物，但这有误导性。收购甘蔗的糖厂归政府所有，政府固定收购价格。然而这并不是误导之处。即使政府将埃及糖业与精炼公司私有化，农民仍然几乎无法选择把甘蔗卖给谁或以什么价格卖。公司拥有窄轨铁路，没有其他便捷方式运输甘蔗。甘蔗一旦砍下，其水分含量和水分中的蔗糖比例会迅速下降，因此必须在数小时内送到糖厂。首次种植后作物要生长十八个月，之后至少还要在地里经历两个九个月的栽培期，因此农民无法对国际糖价的涨落做出反应。

en: What is misleading is the very idea that there could be a free market in sugar. As a crop that requires the year-round sun of tropical or semitropical regions, and one whose harvesting cannot easily be mechanized, cane is the only staple food in the world whose cultivation and export are not dominated by the rich countries of the temperate zone. This anomaly was first overcome three hundred years ago by colonizing the Caribbean and enslaving Africans to grow cane there. (The sugarcane plantation was one of the earliest forms of industrial organization and discipline, as Sidney Mintz has shown, placing slave-based sugar manufacturing at the center of the emergence of capitalist production methods and the system of world trade.

The crop’s history provides another reminder that the market has no essence, but always requires a changing variety of nonmarket methods at its core, sometimes including slavery.) When the United States and Europe lost control of their Caribbean dependencies in the mid-twentieth century, they responded by promoting the cultivation of sugar beet, an inferior crop that requires extensive use of chemical herbicides and had to be protected with price supports and import quotas. Surplus beet sugar was then dumped on the world market, depressing and destabilizing the price of cane sugar and costing its Third World producers billions of dollars each year in lost revenue.
In the second half of the 1990s European Union and American subsidies helped produce a global sugar glut five years in a row, pushing prices below production costs for all countries except Brazil.
The price of sugar in the United States included the hundreds of thousands of dollars the sugar industry paid each year buying votes in Congress in order to keep the subsidy system in place.
zh: 真正误导的是存在食糖自由市场这一想法本身。甘蔗作为一种需要热带或亚热带全年阳光、且收割难以机械化的作物，是世界上唯一一种种植和出口不由温带富国主导的主粮。三百年前，这一异常首次通过殖民加勒比和奴役非洲人种植甘蔗而被克服。（正如西德尼·明茨所表明的，甘蔗种植园是最早的工业组织和纪律形式之一，使以奴隶制为基础的制糖业处于资本主义生产方式和世界贸易体系出现的中心。）
这种作物的历史再次提醒我们，市场没有本质，但总是在其核心需要不断变化的各种非市场方法，有时包括奴隶制。当美国和欧洲在20世纪中叶失去对加勒比属地的控制时，它们通过促进甜菜种植来回应；甜菜是一种劣等作物，需要大量使用化学除草剂，并且必须用价格支持和进口配额来保护。然后，过剩的甜菜糖被倾销到世界市场，压低了甘蔗糖价格并使其不稳定，每年给第三世界生产国造成数十亿美元的收入损失。
1990年代后半期，欧盟和美国的补贴帮助连续五年造成全球食糖过剩，使除巴西外所有国家的价格低于生产成本。
美国食糖价格还包括制糖业每年为维持补贴制度而花费数十万美元在国会买选票。

en: Just as sugarcane cannot easily be understood as a market crop, neither can wheat. There is a similar difficulty in describing the movement of wheat outside the village as a market system. As with sugarcane, cotton, and other major crops, the agricultural policy reforms in Egypt were not able to deregulate the price of wheat. From 1992 private merchants were allowed to import wheat flour, ostensibly creating a free market in white flour. In practice, however, the reform replaced Egyptian government controls with a series of other restrictions and controls, running from the world market to the village merchant.
zh: 正如甘蔗不易被理解为市场作物，小麦也是如此。把小麦运出村庄的运动描述为市场体系，也有类似的困难。与甘蔗、棉花和其他主要作物一样，埃及的农业政策改革无法放开小麦价格。从1992年起，私营商人获准进口小麦面粉，表面上创造了白面粉的自由市场。然而实际上，改革以一系列其他限制和控制取代了埃及政府的控制，从世界市场一直延伸到村庄商人。

en: At the global level, the marketing of wheat was controlled by five or six international grain-trading corporations, most of them privately owned. Production prices depended on an extensive system of U.S. and European Union price supports, required to keep afloat their large and otherwise unprofitable commercial producers. The failure of large-scale commercial wheat production dates back more than a century, as I mentioned in the previous chapter, to the emergence of a global market in wheat between the 1870s and 1930s. As Harriet Friedmann has shown, the emergence of the market did not follow a logic one could describe simply as capitalist. It coincided with a global shift from large-scale commercial farming to the increasing production of wheat by family farms. Relying on their own unpaid labor, household producers were more efficient, flexible, and resilient than large farms using wage labor. (The territorial expansion of the United States, Canada, and other settler states in this period also encouraged, and heavily subsidized, the establishing of family farms.)

From the 1930s, as the crisis of large grain producers worsened, the United States and other governments began to introduce a system of price supports, which Washington extended after World War II into a program of subsidized grain exports that aimed to convert first Europeans and then parts of the Third World into consumers of meat-based diets, which require much higher levels of grain production. In the 1970s and 1980s, as chapter 7 explained, the largest recipient of subsidized U.S. grain was Egypt, where cheap wheat imports helped depress farm incomes and diverted government spending to other sectors, especially the military.
zh: 在全球层面，小麦的销售由五六家国际谷物贸易公司控制，其中大多数为私有。生产价格取决于美国和欧盟广泛的价格支持体系，这些体系是为了让其大型的、本来无利可图的商业生产商维持下去。大规模商业小麦生产的失败可以追溯到一个多世纪以前，正如我在上一章提到的，追溯到1870年代至1930年代全球小麦市场的出现。正如哈丽雅特·弗里德曼所表明的，市场的出现并未遵循一种可以简单称为资本主义的逻辑。它与全球从大规模商业农场向家庭农场日益增加的小麦生产的转变同时发生。依靠自身无偿劳动的家户生产者，比使用雇佣劳动的大农场更有效率、更灵活、更有韧性。（这一时期美国、加拿大和其他移民定居国家的领土扩张也鼓励并大力补贴了家庭农场的建立。）
从1930年代起，随着大型谷物生产者的危机加剧，美国和其他政府开始引入价格支持体系；二战后华盛顿将其扩展为补贴谷物出口计划，旨在先把欧洲人、再把部分第三世界变成以肉类为主饮食的消费者，而这种饮食需要高得多的谷物生产。1970和1980年代，如第7章所解释的，美国补贴谷物的最大接受国是埃及，那里的廉价小麦进口压低了农业收入，并把政府支出转向其他部门，尤其是军队。

en: In the United States and Western Europe, government subsidies kept wheat prices high to protect politically powerful producers. Total annual subsidies in U.S. agriculture reached about $29,000 for each farmer by the mid-1990s (or forty times Egypt’s per capita GNP).
A separate system of support, using food coupons and welfare payments, made bread affordable for the poor.

In Egypt, where producers had no political power and a far greater proportion of the population could not afford the inflated prices of the world grain market, the government used subsidies differently, to keep consumer prices low. As was mentioned earlier, in the later 1980s the United States began to demand market prices for its wheat, forcing Egypt to embark on the program of agricultural policy reform. The government eliminated subsidies for most other goods, cut the quantity and quality of subsidized flour, and began adding corn flour to the wheat. Despite strong U.S. and IMF pressure to abolish bread subsidies entirely, however, the government was unable to eliminate the program. The private sector wheat market had to coexist with the system of government supply.
zh: 在美国和西欧，政府补贴使小麦价格保持在高位，以保护政治上强大的生产者。到1990年代中期，美国农业的年度补贴总额达到每个农民约29,000美元（是埃及人均国民生产总值的四十倍）。
另一套使用食品券和福利支付的支助系统使穷人买得起面包。

在埃及，生产者没有政治权力，而且有更大比例的人口负担不起世界粮食市场膨胀的价格，政府则不同地使用补贴，以压低消费价格。如前所述，1980年代后期，美国开始要求其小麦按市场价格出售，迫使埃及开始农业政策改革计划。政府取消了大多数其他商品的补贴，削减了补贴面粉的数量和质量，并开始在小麦粉中掺入玉米粉。然而，尽管美国和IMF施加了强烈压力要求完全取消面包补贴，政府仍无法取消该计划。私营部门的小麦市场不得不与政府供应体系并存。

en: Farmers in the village were now caught in the resulting confusion. The Ministry of Agriculture claimed to have ended the system of area restrictions, quotas, and fixed procurement prices. The Ministry of Supply and Commerce, however, working with the local government authorities, still attempted to procure about 12 to 15 percent of local wheat production at a fixed price (E£100 per ardeb in 1996 and 1997).

The government-run landreform cooperatives, which supplied seeds and fertilizer to beneficiaries of the 1952 land reform, demanded in return that the owners of each holding (the nimra, or original land-reform unit, which was legally indivisible but in practice usually shared among several second- or third-generation owners) sell to the government one ardeb (150 kilograms) of wheat. In the summer of 1996 a crisis erupted when the price of wheat on the commercial market rose much higher than the government’s price and the Ministry of Supply was unable to obtain its wheat. The Qina governorate authorities responded by suspending development projects in any village that failed to supply its quota, forcing farmers to supply the missing wheat by purchasing it on the market, where prices jumped even higher. The authorities also reduced the supply of subsidized flour to each distributor. In Aswan governorate to the south, local authorities required that anyone seeking permits of any kind or other government assistance produce a document showing that they had supplied their quota of wheat. In at least one district this requirement was imposed on every village household, including those growing no wheat or even farming no land at all. To obtain the appropriate document, villagers had to pay the cooperative a sum covering the cost of purchasing wheat on the market to resell to the government. The authorities had banned the transport of wheat between governorates, so villages had to smuggle supplies through the desert to avoid the roadblocks and inspection points that now operated like international frontiers on the main roads.
The official accounts of Egypt’s successful transition to a rural market economy did not discuss these unusual arrangements.
zh: 村里的农民如今被夹在由此产生的混乱之中。农业部声称已结束面积限制、配额和固定收购价格制度。然而，供应与商业部与地方政府当局合作，仍试图以固定价格（1996年和1997年每阿代卜100埃镑）收购当地小麦产量的约12%至15%。

政府经营的土改合作社向1952年土地改革受益者提供种子和化肥，作为回报要求每份地产的所有者（nimra，即原土改单位，法律上不可分割，但实践中通常在第二代或第三代几个所有者之间分配）向政府出售一阿代卜（150公斤）小麦。1996年夏天爆发危机，商业市场上的小麦价格远高于政府价格，供应部无法获得其小麦。基纳省当局的回应是暂停任何未能供应配额的村庄的发展项目，迫使农民到市场购买缺失的小麦，而市场价格涨得更高。当局还减少了每个分销商的补贴面粉供应。在南边的阿斯旺省，地方当局要求任何寻求任何许可或其他政府援助的人出示已交售小麦配额的证明。至少在一个区，这项要求被施加于每个村庄家户，包括不种小麦甚至不耕种任何土地的家户。为了获得相应证明，村民必须向合作社支付一笔钱，用于在市场上购买小麦再转售给政府。当局禁止小麦在各省之间运输，因此村庄不得不通过沙漠走私供应，以避开公路上的路障和检查站——这些检查站如今运作得像主要公路上的国际边界。
关于埃及成功过渡到农村市场经济的官方叙述没有讨论这些不寻常的安排。

en: There are further reasons why the movement of wheat outside the village did not resemble the model of a free market. The international cartel of grain-trading corporations that controlled world supplies was now copied within Egypt. A small group of merchants controlled the commercial importing of wheat flour and fixed the price.

Within the village itself, the commercial distribution of flour was also tending toward a local oligopoly. Three or four merchants in the village had official concessions to sell subsidized flour from the Ministry of Supply. Commercial sales of flour were now concentrated in the same hands. By far the biggest of these merchants was Hasan Qinawi, who with his brother Ibrahim inherited his father’s village shop and transformed it in the mid-1990s into the dominant local business.
zh: 把小麦运出村庄之所以不像自由市场模式，还有进一步原因。控制世界供应的国际谷物贸易公司卡特尔如今在埃及国内被复制。一小群商人控制小麦面粉的商业进口并固定价格。
在村庄内部，面粉的商业分销也趋于地方寡头垄断。村里三四个商人拥有供应部出售补贴面粉的官方特许权。面粉的商业销售如今也集中在同一批人手中。其中最大的是哈桑·齐纳维，他和兄弟易卜拉欣继承了父亲的村中店铺，并在1990年代中期把它变成当地占主导地位的生意。

en: The history of this merchant household reflects the complexity of the changes that had been taking place. The Qinawi family was said to have its roots in the long-distance trade with the Sudan. Little of this trade—once an important activity of the village, which lies near the start of one of the old desert routes to the south—remained after the middle of the twentieth century.

The Qinawis’ father made his living from a different longdistance trade that flourished in the region in the 1950s and 1960s, the supply of eggs by train to Cairo. Beginning as a middleman who went from door to door collecting eggs from the women who raised poultry, he later built a large hatchery, the remains of which four decades later still stood next to the family house. In the 1970s the poultry trade too was wiped out, partly by the decline of local grain production after the Aswan Dam made possible the extension of sugarcane cultivation, and partly by the rise of factory egg and poultry production in the north, subsidized with IMF loans and nonmarket U.S. feed grains. One of these giant poultry factories in the Delta was where one or two of the Qinawis’ poorer neighbors now found work, including the migrant husband of Zaynab.
zh: 这个商人家族的历史反映了正在发生的变化的复杂性。据说齐纳维家族源于与苏丹的长途贸易。这一贸易——曾经是该村的一项重要活动，因为村庄位于通往南方的几条古老沙漠路线的起点附近——在20世纪中叶以后所剩无几。

齐纳维的父亲靠1950和1960年代在该地区兴盛的另一项长途贸易谋生：用火车向开罗供应鸡蛋。他起初是个中间商，挨家挨户从养禽的妇女那里收鸡蛋，后来建了一座大型孵化场，四十年后其遗迹仍立在家族住宅旁。1970年代，家禽贸易也被摧毁，部分原因是阿斯旺大坝使甘蔗种植扩大后当地谷物生产下降，部分原因是北方工厂化蛋禽生产的兴起，后者得到IMF贷款和非市场美国饲料谷物的补贴。三角洲这些巨型家禽工厂之一，正是齐纳维一两个较穷的邻居如今找到工作的地方，包括扎伊纳布那外出务工的丈夫。

en: The father survived the collapse of the local egg industry. He had become a general merchant and moneylender dealing especially in wheat and had opened a small shop built into the outer wall of his large house. Following the last round of land transfers in the 1960s, when the state sequestered land from some of those who had evaded or profited from the earlier reforms, he acquired fifty acres from an estate in a neighboring village. (Its owner was a local magnate who had managed the estate of Ahmed ʿAbbud, the sugar baron of chapter 1, and extended his own holdings after the 1952 land reform broke up ʿAbbud’s six-thousand-acre property. In the 1960s this local magnate’s own property was sequestrated and he moved abroad, returning a decade later after President Sadat reversed the final sequestrations. He now ran the estate, a large hotel across the river in Luxor, and several other operations from his home near Armant—the restored country house of ʿAbbud.) Qinawi was able to send his sons to study in the faculty of commerce at one of Cairo’s large universities, an education useful less for what the sons were taught than for the connections they made with the sons of other merchant families in Cairo and throughout Upper Egypt. They returned home after their father’s death, built a warehouse next to the mosque that faced the house (and which the father had built and recently renovated and enlarged), and turned his shop into the center of a large wholesale business, using their college merchant connections to ship in goods for all the smaller shopkeepers in the village. Within three years they had built a larger warehouse on the main road and another across the river in Luxor, and they were beginning to monopolize the supply of flour in the district, as well as certain supplies to the big tourist hotels, including a new brand of mineral water called Safi. (Safiwas introduced by the food and beverages arm of the Egyptian military, the country’s largest agribusiness operation, whose unpaid labor force represented another forced labor system within the so-called market.)
zh: 父亲挺过了当地蛋业的崩溃。他成了兼营各种商品的商人和放贷者，尤其经营小麦，并在自家大宅的外墙上开了一间小铺。1960年代最后一轮土地转移中——国家从一些逃避或从早先改革中获利的人手中征收了土地——他从邻村一处地产购得五十费丹。（该地产原属当地一位显贵，此人曾管理第1章那位食糖大亨艾哈迈德·阿布德的庄园，并在1952年土地改革拆散阿布德六千费丹的产业后扩大了自己的地产。1960年代，这位本地显贵自己的产业被征收，他移居国外，十年后萨达特总统撤销最后几轮征收后才返回。他如今经营着那座庄园、河对岸卢克索的一家大饭店，以及若干其他生意，办公起居就在阿尔曼特附近的家中——那是阿布德修复后的乡间宅邸。）齐纳维得以送儿子们去开罗一所规模很大的大学念商学院；所受教育有用的与其说是儿子们学到的东西，不如说是他们与开罗及上埃及各地其他商人子弟建立的关系。父亲去世后，儿子们回到家乡，在正对宅子的清真寺旁盖了一座仓库（这座清真寺是父亲所建，最近又翻修扩建过），并把他的小铺变成一家大型批发业务的中心，利用大学里结交的商人关系，为村里所有小店主进货。三年之内，他们在主干道上建了更大的仓库，又在河对岸的卢克索建了一座，并开始垄断本地区的面粉供应，以及向大型旅游饭店供应某些物品，包括一种名叫“萨菲”的新品牌矿泉水。（“萨菲”由埃及军方这家全国最大农业综合企业的食品饮料部门推出，其无偿劳动力代表着所谓市场内部的另一种强制劳动制度。）

en: Most of the women who used to supply eggs to the father could no longer afford the factory-produced eggs. In the late 1980s the supply of nonmarket U.S. feed grains was cut as part of the program of agricultural price reforms. At the same time the government lifted a ban on imported frozen poultry, flooding the market with cheap supplies from the United States and the European Union, where subsidies had not been cut. Most of the country’s commercial egg and poultry industry collapsed. The poultry population was cut in half between 1984 and 1989, and per capita egg consumption dropped from eighty eggs a year to fifty-three. Only the largest producers survived (including the one in the Delta that employed men from the village), building integrated operations with their own feed mills and distribution systems. By the early 1990s they formed a small cartel controlling prices and supply.

With more by-products from their own farming to use as animal feed, and unable to afford cartel prices, women in the village began to raise increasing numbers of their own poultry. Zaynab, for example, was raising at any one time a dozen or more pigeons, an equal number of chickens, and half a dozen ducks and geese, alongside the water buffalo and up to two dozen sheep and goats. Most farming households in the village raised a similar number and range of animals, although the poorer could not afford the buffalo while the wealthiest might have several buffalo and cows. Women sold surplus poultry and eggs among neighbors and at the weekly market in the neighboring village, where their numbers sometimes rivaled those of regular merchants selling vegetables, feed grains, and household supplies. Poultry raised at home also replaced beef purchased from the butcher for Thursday dinner, the one meat meal of the week for most households, many of whom could no longer afford to purchase meat following the reforms.
zh: 过去向父亲供应鸡蛋的妇女，大多再也买不起工厂生产的鸡蛋了。1980年代后期，作为农业价格改革计划的一部分，美国非市场饲料谷物的供应被削减。与此同时，政府取消了进口冷冻禽肉的禁令，来自美国和欧盟的廉价产品涌入市场——那里的补贴并未削减。全国大部分商业蛋禽业崩溃。1984年至1989年间家禽存栏量减少一半，人均鸡蛋消费量从每年八十枚降至五十三枚。只有最大的生产者幸存下来（包括三角洲那家雇用村里男子做工的厂子），它们建起拥有自己的饲料厂和配送体系的纵向一体化经营。到1990年代初，少数幸存企业形成了一个控制价格和供应的小卡特尔。

由于自家种养产生的副产品更多，可用作饲料，又负担不起卡特尔的价格，村里的妇女开始养更多家禽。例如，扎伊纳布任何时候都养着十几只乃至更多的鸽子、同样数量的鸡，还有五六只鸭和鹅，此外还有水牛和最多二十来只绵羊山羊。村里大多数农户饲养的牲畜数量和种类与之相似，只是较穷的人家养不起水牛，而最富的人家可能有好几头水牛和奶牛。妇女们在邻里之间以及邻村的每周集市上出售多余的家禽和鸡蛋；在那种集市上，她们的人数有时与那些贩卖蔬菜、饲料谷物和日用品的固定商贩不相上下。自家养的家禽还取代了从肉铺买来的牛肉，用于星期四晚餐——那是多数家庭一周里唯一一顿肉食，而改革之后，许多家庭已经买不起肉了。

en: This is the story of one merchant family and one village. Its usefulness is not for making any general point about the impact of market reforms but to argue against general points. It illustrates the great variety of factors at work in the attempt to introduce a market system, many of them incompatible with any abstract definition of a market. With poultry, as with wheat, the result of the market reforms was nothing like a market system. A similar debacle occurred with fertilizer: when the government ended its control over the supply of fertilizer in 1994, an oligopoly of three producers took over the supply and quadrupled the price, forcing the government to reassume control.
All these developments reflected not a failure to implement the reforms, but their interaction with existing networks and logics that resituated and transposed them.
zh: 这是一个商人家族和一个村庄的故事。其用处不在于就市场改革的影响得出任何总体论断，而在于反对总体论断。它说明了在引入市场制度的尝试中起作用的各种因素多么繁杂，其中许多与任何抽象的市场定义都不相容。同小麦一样，家禽业改革的结果根本不像一种市场制度。化肥也发生了类似的溃败：1994年政府结束对化肥供应的控制后，三家生产商组成的寡头接管了供应，把价格提高到四倍，迫使政府重新接管。
所有这些发展反映的不是改革实施的失败，而是改革与既有网络和逻辑的相互作用——这些网络和逻辑重新安放并置换了改革。

en: I want to return one last time to the issue of bread. The market in flour could not function freely as a market, as we have seen, in part because for most people in Egypt bread is the staple food. The government had reduced or eliminated almost all other food subsidies, but could not end the supply of subsidized bread. In the village bread formed a large part of almost everyone’s diet. Compared to the flat loaves of ʿaish baladi eaten in the towns, the thick ʿaish shamshi loaf produced in the villages of the south was extremely filling. For the poorest households it was almost the only food, taken with a cup of black tea at breakfast (the tea helped kill the appetite) and dipped in a bowl of mulukhiyya to give it moisture as the main meal.
zh: 我想最后一次回到面包问题。如我们所见，面粉市场无法作为市场自由运作，部分原因是面包是埃及多数人的主食。政府已经减少或取消了几乎所有其他食品补贴，却无法终止补贴面包的供应。在村里，面包构成几乎所有人日常饮食的一大部分。与城里吃的扁平 ʿaish baladi 饼相比，南方村庄制作的厚实 ʿaish shamshi 大饼极其管饱。对最贫困的家庭来说，它几乎是唯一的食物：早饭就着一杯红茶吃（茶能压住食欲），正餐则泡在一碗锦葵汤里，让它湿润好咽。

en: The basic nourishment that bread could provide was the result of a major resource within the village, a resource that shaped the wheat market yet could not itself be marketed: the labor of bread making. The work women did in kneading and baking their bread and supplying fuel for the bread oven was one of the most important means of creating household wealth. Most women baked every four or five days, often working jointly with a sister-in-law, neighbor, or daughter kept home from school that day to share the labor of producing fifty or sixty loaves. The work was integrated with the other household labor of child rearing, laundry, cooking, and cleaning, and was closely connected with animal raising. Pats of buffalo dung, together with the remains of the maize or corn leaves used as animal fodder mixed with dung from the donkey, provided the main source of fuel for the bread oven. (Households needing extra supplies could spread a little dung on leaves in the lane outside the house, its smell provoking every passing donkey to provide some more.) Cardboard boxes, used school notebooks, and other forms of refuse in the village provided an additional source of fuel. Tourist groups from Luxor that visited the temple near Zaynab’s house brought boxed lunches, whose packaging she had arranged to recycle in her oven. Dried scraps of bread from her table were never wasted, but carefully collected and fed to the poultry. Even the ashes from the bread oven were reused, as fertilizer in the fields.
zh: 面包所能提供的基本营养，来自村内一项重要的资源；这项资源塑造了小麦市场，本身却无法进入市场：做面包的劳动。妇女和面、烤饼并为面包炉提供燃料的劳动，是创造家庭财富最重要的手段之一。多数妇女每四五天烤一次，常与嫂子或弟媳、邻居，或那天被留在家里不上学的女儿合作，分担做出五六十张饼的劳动。这项劳动与育儿、洗衣、做饭和打扫等其他家务结合在一起，并与饲养牲畜密切相关。一块块水牛粪，加上用作牲口饲料的玉米叶残渣混着驴粪，是面包炉的主要燃料来源。（需要额外燃料的家庭可以在屋外小巷的树叶上摊一点粪，粪味会引得每头路过的驴再多贡献一些。）纸板箱、用过的学校作业本以及村里其他形式的垃圾，提供了额外的燃料来源。从卢克索来参观扎伊纳布家附近神庙的旅游团带有盒装午餐，她已设法把那些包装回收，放进自家炉子里烧。餐桌上干掉的碎面包从不浪费，而是仔细收起来喂家禽。就连面包炉的灰也再利用，撒到田里当肥料。

en: This form of food production could not be reproduced commercially, given the market costs of fuel and labor, so ʿaish shamshi was not available for purchase. In the wealthiest landowning households, women who were spared some of the other chores of animal raising and collecting fodder still produced their own bread. Even the handful of younger, better-off women who lived in the small apartment buildings near the ferry, from where their husbands commuted to work as lawyers or pharmacists in Luxor, still usually returned to their mothers’ homes in the village every few days to bake bread.
zh: 考虑到燃料和劳动的市场成本，这种食品生产方式不可能商业化复制，因此 ʿaish shamshi 买不到。在最富有的地主家庭，妇女虽免去了饲养牲畜、收集饲料等部分家务，仍自己制作面包。就连住在渡口附近小公寓楼里的少数几位较年轻、较富裕的妇女，也通常每隔几天回到村里娘家烤面包——她们的丈夫从那渡口通勤去卢克索当律师或药剂师。

en: The system of self-provisioning would begin with the growing of wheat and the raising of domestic animals. No household was self-sufficient, for most lacked enough land to support themselves entirely, and those with large landholdings purchased tea, sugar, and other goods they could not grow. But self-provisioning involved far more than the resources represented by government figures for wheat production and numbers of farm animals. The village household produced its staple diet not only by raising crops and animals but by an intensive system of food manufacture. Neither the labor used to make bread nor the fuel was a market commodity. The same is true of the labor used in milking the buffalo and producing cheese, clarified butter, and other household milk products, or in preparing poultry to eat. This manufacturing system was probably the country’s largest industry, at least in terms of the numbers it employed and the mouths it helped feed. Yet it had no official place in the government’s program of agricultural reforms. Contemporary methods of estimating the country’s gross domestic product (GDP) included some guess at the value of crops directly consumed by those who grow them. But the reforms were concerned with removing obstacles to the operation of market laws and grasped the nature of Egyptian agriculture according to the model of a market. This model has no place for the industry of domestic food manufacture and the crops and livestock that supported it, except a residual and insignificant one.
zh: 自给自足体系始于种植小麦和饲养家畜。没有哪个家庭是完全自给自足的，因为多数家庭土地不足，无法完全养活自己；而拥有大片土地的家庭也要购买茶叶、食糖和其他种不出来的物品。但自给自足所涉及的资源，远远超出政府统计中代表小麦产量和牲畜数量的那些数字。村里的家庭不仅靠种植作物和饲养牲畜来生产主食，还靠一套密集的食品加工体系。做面包所用的劳动和燃料都不是市场商品。挤水牛奶、制作奶酪、澄清黄油（酥油）和其他家庭奶制品，以及处理家禽以供食用所用的劳动，同样如此。这套加工体系可能是全国最大的产业，至少从雇用人数和它帮助养活的人口来看如此。然而它在政府的农业改革计划中没有正式位置。当时估算该国国内生产总值（GDP）的方法，包括对种植者直接消费的作物价值作某种猜测。但改革关心的是消除市场规律运行的障碍，并按照市场模型来把握埃及农业的性质。这个模型没有为家庭食品加工业及其所依赖的作物和牲畜留出位置，至多只给一个残余而无关紧要的位置。

en: The result of reformers implementing the model of the market was to demonstrate its failure. Ending the compulsory government purchase of crops at low prices probably stimulated production. The yields of several major crops appeared to have increased significantly. But some of this increase may have been due to more accurate reporting and much of the rest to the continuing introduction of high yielding crop varieties, which have no necessary connection with market principles. (In the 1990s Egypt held the world record for yields of sugarcane, the one crop that the government still entirely controlled.) In general, the free-market reforms produced results opposite from those their proponents anticipated. Instead of moving toward high value export crops such as cotton and vegetables, farmers increased their production of staples such as wheat, maize, and rice. Markets did not work because of monopolization, hoarding, speculation, and the exposure of farmers to international price swings that everywhere in the world make free-market farming impossible. To deal with the instability their programs had caused, the reformers began to call for the introduction of futures markets, to enable farmers to sell their crops in advance at more stable prices. But futures markets seldom work for small farmers and tend simply to open up another field of financial speculation, shifting more of the income away from those who grow the food.
Better alternatives, such as farmer-run marketing cooperatives, which play a major role in Europe and the United States, were ignored by organizations like USAID and in some cases actively opposed.

Instead, the government was obliged to manage the crises by retaining or reintroducing acreage controls and floor prices. Even the reformers acknowledged, furthermore, that “the costs” of their policies, as they put it, had “become much more apparent.” The costs they listed, with no hint of self-recrimination, included “growing unemployment, falling real wages, higher prices for basic goods and services, and widespread loss of economic security.”
zh: 改革者实施市场模型的结果，恰恰证明了它的失败。结束政府低价强制收购作物，很可能刺激了生产。几种主要作物的单产似乎显著提高。但这种增长一部分可能源于更准确的报告，其余大部分则源于高产品种的持续引进——这与市场原则没有必然联系。（1990年代，埃及的甘蔗单产保持世界纪录，而甘蔗正是政府仍完全控制的唯一作物。）总体而言，自由市场改革产生的结果与其支持者的预期相反。农民没有转向棉花和蔬菜等高价值出口作物，反而增加了小麦、玉米和水稻等主粮的生产。市场没有有效运作，原因在于垄断、囤积、投机，以及农民受制于国际价格波动——这种波动在世界各地都使自由市场农业无法运转。为应对其计划造成的不稳定，改革者开始呼吁引入期货市场，让农民能够以较稳定的价格预售作物。但期货市场对小农很少有效，往往只是开辟了另一个金融投机领域，把更多收入从种粮者手中转移走。
更好的替代方案——例如在欧洲和美国发挥重要作用的农民自办销售合作社——却被美国国际开发署（USAID）这类组织忽视，有时还遭到积极反对。
相反，政府不得不通过保留或重新引入种植面积控制和保底价格来管理危机。此外，就连改革者也承认，用他们的话说，其政策的“代价”已“变得明显得多”。他们列出的代价——毫无自责之意——包括“失业加剧、实际工资下降、基本商品和服务价格上涨，以及经济保障的普遍丧失”。

en: Reformers claimed that these hardships were the necessary price for removing the barriers to agricultural growth. Once the growth began, the hardships would be overcome. Since removing the barriers exposed farmers to global price instability and local price fixing, however, it did not stimulate real growth. The World Bank had claimed that the old system of price controls was penalizing farmers and reducing agricultural GDP by 20 percent.
Yet in the seven years following the removal of controls in 1986, despite the reported increase in yields, agricultural GDP stagnated or even declined.

The reformers subsequently admitted that they did not know whether the old price controls had depressed output or what effect government interventions had on overall agricultural performance, an ignorance they had failed to mention when advocating the reforms.

Moreover, apparent success in the other major area of economic reform, currency stabilization (see chapter 9), encouraged large flows of foreign capital into Egypt, which the IMF claimed were causing the Egyptian pound to become overvalued in relation to the dollar, perhaps by as much as 30 percent.
If so, the decline of real agricultural income, as well as the obstacles to the further promotion of agricultural exports, was even greater.
zh: 改革者声称，这些困苦是消除农业增长障碍的必要代价。一旦增长启动，困苦就会被克服。然而，由于消除障碍使农民暴露于全球价格不稳定和地方价格操纵之下，它并没有刺激真正的增长。世界银行曾声称，旧的价格控制制度惩罚农民，使农业GDP减少20%。
然而在1986年取消控制之后的七年里，尽管报告的单产有所提高，农业GDP却停滞甚至下降。
改革者后来承认，他们不知道旧的价格控制是否压低了产量，也不知道政府干预对农业总体表现有何影响——这种无知在倡导改革时他们并未提及。
此外，经济改革另一主要领域——货币稳定（见第9章）——表面上的成功，促使大量外国资本流入埃及；国际货币基金组织（IMF）声称这使埃及镑对美元高估，幅度可能高达30%。
若果真如此，实际农业收入的下降以及进一步促进农业出口的障碍就更严重了。

en: Far from a temporary phenomenon, the costs of the reforms were to become a central part of the reformers’ long-term plans for rural Egypt. Following the creation of a commercial market in crops, the next goal was a free market in land. The 1952 agrarian reform gave agricultural tenants and their heirs security against eviction and fixed the maximum rent at seven times the land tax. The U.S. government and international financial agencies argued that this arrangement was “creating disincentives to a more efficient use of land,” although there was no evidence to support this view.

A law to abolish the 1952 reform was pushed through parliament in 1992 by the ruling National Democratic Party and the right-wing Wafd, the party of old landowning families (including the minister of agriculture).

The law raised the maximum rent from seven to twenty-two times the land tax for a five-year transition period, after which rents and tenancies were to be unregulated and all tenants could be evicted. Parliament enacted the law without any studies of its possible impact, nor even accurate figures about the number of tenants affected or the size of their landholdings.
zh: 改革的代价远非暂时现象，而将成为改革者对埃及农村长期规划的核心部分。在建立作物的商业市场之后，下一个目标是土地的自由市场。1952年土地改革使农业佃农及其继承人免遭驱逐，并把最高地租固定为土地税的七倍。美国政府和国际金融机构争辩说，这一安排“抑制了更有效地利用土地”，尽管没有证据支持这种观点。
1992年，执政的民族民主党和右翼华夫脱党——古老地主家族（包括农业部长）的政党——推动议会通过了一项废除1952年改革的法律。
该法在五年过渡期内把最高地租从土地税的七倍提高到二十二倍，此后地租和租佃关系不再受管制，所有佃农都可能被驱逐。议会通过该法时，没有对其可能影响作任何研究，甚至没有关于受影响佃农人数或其土地面积的准确数字。

en: Popular opposition to the law was muted by a security regime that outlawed any form of unlicensed political activity—a regime that considerably tightened its grip during the period of free-market reforms—and at the same time by repeated suggestions from the government that the law would not seriously be implemented. Although it carried out the initial tripling of land rents, to twenty-two times the land tax, the government announced in October 1996 that this rent ceiling would be retained for an additional five-year period, until 2002.
By the end of 1996, however, farmers began to learn from changes at the local government cooperatives that the law would go ahead, and the protests began.

On December 31, 1996, tenant farmers from villages near Bani Suwaif, eighty miles south of Cairo, gathered on the main railway line and began stopping trains running to and from Cairo, then marched to the office of the provincial governor and demanded the abrogation of the law. The security forces arrested ten of the farmers.
The two opposition newspapers that reported this and similar events were later shut down.
zh: 公众对该法的反对被两种因素压制：一是禁止任何未经许可的政治活动的安全体制——这一体制在自由市场改革时期大幅收紧了控制；二是政府一再暗示该法不会认真执行。尽管政府实施了最初阶段的地租三倍上涨，达到土地税的二十二倍，但它在1996年10月宣布这一租金上限将再保留五年，直到2002年。
然而到1996年底，农民开始从地方政府合作社的变化中得知该法将继续推行，抗议随之开始。
1996年12月31日，开罗以南八十英里的贝尼苏韦夫附近村庄的佃农聚集在主干铁路线上，开始拦截往来开罗的列车，随后游行到省长办公室，要求废除该法。安全部队逮捕了十名农民。
报道此事及类似事件的两家反对派报纸后来被查封。

en: When the law was finally implemented in October 1997, the protests escalated, as did the violence of the state. The Land Center for Human Rights, set up to defend the claims of small farmers, reported that in 1997 and 1998 49 people were killed in disputes relating to the new law, 956 were injured, and 2,785 were arrested. In the first six months of 1999 another 17 lost their lives, 205 were injured, and 375 were arrested. Some of those arrested were also tortured.
Meanwhile, the government passed a new law to regulate nongovernment organizations such as the Land Center, banning their involvement in political activities.
zh: 1997年10月该法最终实施时，抗议升级，国家的暴力也升级。为维护小农权益而设立的土地人权中心报告说，1997年和1998年有49人在与新法有关的纠纷中丧生，956人受伤，2,785人被捕。1999年头六个月，又有17人丧生，205人受伤，375人被捕。一些被捕者还遭受了酷刑。
与此同时，政府通过了一项新法律，管制土地人权中心这类非政府组织，禁止它们参与政治活动。

en: The impact of the tenancy law varied greatly from one village and district to the next, because tenancy arrangements depended on the history of estate formation, land distribution, and out-migration in a particular place.

Of the 905,000 tenant farmers affected, it was estimated that 432,000, or almost half, became landless (12,000 of these, or less than 1.5 percent of those affected, were given alternative land to farm by the government). The other half managed to continue farming, either because they owned other plots of land or because they renegotiated the tenancy.

These farmers experienced the change in the law less abruptly, as one more part of the pressure forcing them over several years into a harsher and more difficult life. “They put us in the mill,” said Sayyid, a farmer in the village, “and turn it and turn it.”
zh: 租佃法的影响因村庄和地区而差异极大，因为租佃安排取决于特定地方的地产形成、土地分配和人口外迁的历史。
在受影响的905,000名佃农中，估计有432,000人——将近一半——失去了土地（其中12,000人，即受影响者的不到1.5%，获得政府提供的替代耕地）。另一半设法继续务农，或者因为他们还拥有其他地块，或者因为他们重新谈成了租佃。
这些农民感受到法律的变化没有那么突然，只是把它当作多年来迫使他们过上更严酷、更艰难生活的压力中的又一部分。“他们把我们放进磨里，”村里一位农民赛义德说，“一遍遍地磨。”

en: The impact of the law also varied with the factors and forces it interacted with, especially those of local family power. In some cases it was unenforceable in the village I studied. Rajab rented one of the four acres his family farmed and was able to prevent the owners from reclaiming it. Although the owners lived in a neighboring hamlet of the same village, they were the second-generation heirs of the original owner and had no idea of the exact location of the dispersed fragments to which they had title.

Even if they were to locate them, they would have no path to access them, as the land was now enclosed within the larger holdings of Rajab and his brothers. Nor were they powerful enough to find the political support they needed within the village to take back the land. On the other hand, a young widowed woman whose inherited landholding of less than an acre was rented out to a wealthy relative with more than fifty acres was able to reclaim the land. The latter at first refused but was persuaded when other relatives and the heads of the village intervened, arguing that the woman had no other means of support. In this case the ending of a tenancy contract created the opposite effect to that intended by the proponents of free-market reforms, removing land from a large commercial farm and returning it to a household-based woman farmer. Once again the logic of the free market produced different outcomes when displaced by other logics at work in the village.
zh: 该法的影响也随其相互作用的各种因素和力量而变化，尤其是当地家族势力。在某些情况下，它在我研究的村庄里无法执行。拉贾卜租种了他家四费丹地中的一费丹，并得以阻止地主收回。尽管地主住在同村相邻的小村，他们是原主人的第二代继承人，根本不知道他们所持有产权证的那些分散地块的确切位置。

即使他们找到了地块，也无路可进，因为这块地如今被围在拉贾卜兄弟更大的田产之中。他们也没有足够势力在村内找到收回土地所需的政治支持。另一方面，一位年轻寡妇继承了不到一费丹土地，租给了一个拥有五十多费丹地的富裕亲戚，她却能把地收回。后者起初拒绝，但在其他亲戚和村庄头面人物介入、辩称这名妇女别无生计之后，被说服了。在这个案例中，终止租佃合同产生了与自由市场改革支持者本意相反的效果：它把土地从一个大型商业农场拿走，交还给一位以家庭为基础经营的女农。自由市场的逻辑再度被村里运行的其他逻辑取代，从而产生了不同的结果。

en: The eviction of tenant farmers was not the only part of the reformers’ longer-term plans. A conference in Cairo in March 1995 bringing together representatives of USAID, the Ministry of Agriculture, agribusiness consulting firms, and some of the U.S. and Egyptian academics they employed concluded that Egypt’s agricultural future depended principally on increased use of technology to encourage “falling labor use,” which in turn would release additional labor for industrial employment. This surplus labor, together with lower prices paid to farmers for producing food, would “help keep real urban wages low and industry more profitable.”
The transitional costs of higher unemployment, falling real wages, and increased economic insecurity were now revealed as a long-term goal of the reforms.
zh: 驱逐佃农并非改革者长期计划的唯一部分。1995年3月在开罗召开的一次会议，汇集了美国国际开发署、农业部、农业综合企业咨询公司以及它们雇用的若干美国和埃及学者的代表；会议得出结论，埃及农业的未来主要取决于更多地使用技术来促成“劳动使用量下降”，这反过来会释放出额外劳动力供工业雇用。这些过剩劳动力，加上付给农民生产食品的更低价格，将“有助于使城市实际工资保持低位，并提高工业利润”。
失业上升、实际工资下降和经济不安全感加剧这些“过渡性代价”，如今显露为改革的长期目标。

en: Perhaps to hasten this process of pauperization, the conference repeated the demand of the U.S. government and the IMF for the early removal of the remaining subsidies on bread and flour, on the grounds that keeping staple food affordable resulted in “waste” and “excess consumption,” proposing instead that a smaller amount of aid be given to the “ultrapoor 20 percent of the population.”
This smaller subsidy would not have covered the proportion known, even before the impact of the reforms, to be suffering from serious malnutrition.

The decrease in the subsidy might have increased the proportion of those suffering from malnutrition, for there was no evidence that those who were eating subsidized bread were guilty of overconsumption. Even among the two-thirds of the population classified as nonpoor, food accounted on average for almost 50 percent of household expenditure, a large part of it consisting of bread and other carbohydrates. Surveys indicated that the average calorie intake of this better-off two-thirds remained below the minimum recommended allowance, even before most of the price increases and wage cuts of the 1990s.
zh: 或许是为了加速这一贫困化进程，会议重申了美国政府和IMF的要求：尽早取消对面包和面粉的剩余补贴，理由是让主食价格可负担会导致“浪费”和“过度消费”，并提议改为向“最贫困的20%人口”提供较少的援助。
这一较少的补贴不足以覆盖那些在改革影响之前就已知患有严重营养不良的人群比例。
补贴减少可能已扩大了营养不良者的比例，因为没有证据表明吃补贴面包的人犯有过度消费之过。即使在被归为非贫困的那三分之二人口中，食品平均占家庭支出的近50%，其中很大一部分是面包和其他碳水化合物。调查表明，即使在1990年代大多数价格上涨和工资削减之前，这较富裕的三分之二人口的平均热量摄入仍低于建议的最低摄入量。

en: If the U.S. government was concerned with waste and excess consumption, it needed to look elsewhere. Its own estimates suggest that 5 percent of Egypt’s population were affluent by U.S. standards and that the top 2 percent (more than one million people) were “exceptionally and often ostentatiously wealthy.”

There was no evidence that this class purchased a significant quantity of subsidized bread (the bread reached only 75 percent of the urban population in 1984, after which it had declined in quality and availability).

The wealth and consumption of the affluent had increased with the U.S.-led reforms, widening the gap that separated them from the remaining 95 percent. In 1994 the United Nations’ Human Development Report categorized Egypt as one of four countries “in danger of joining the world’s list of failed states because of wide income gaps between sections of their population.”
zh: 如果美国政府关心浪费和过度消费，它需要把目光投向别处。它自己的估计表明，埃及5%的人口按美国标准算得上富裕，而最上层的2%（一百多万人）“格外富有，且往往摆阔炫富”。
没有证据表明这个阶层购买了大量补贴面包（1984年补贴面包只覆盖75%的城市人口，此后质量和可获得性均有下降）。
富裕阶层的财富和消费随着美国主导的改革而增加，扩大了他们与其余95%人口之间的差距。1994年，联合国《人类发展报告》把埃及列为四个“因人口各部分之间收入差距悬殊而面临加入世界失败国家名单之险”的国家之一。

en: Reading the proposals and reports of the proponents of free-market reforms for Egyptian agriculture, one is struck by the almost complete absence from their accounts of any of the detail or particularity of rural Egypt. One encounters no farmers or villages in their writing. Much more, too, is missing. Many of the most sweeping reform proposals were unsupported by adequate evidence. The demands to abolish price controls, crop quotas, food subsidies, and the protection of tenants were made with no reliable knowledge about the effects of these programs or the likely consequences of their removal. The result of removing them was a decline in rates of agricultural growth, a shift away from high value crops such as cotton, a large drop in Egypt’s most valuable manufactured export, cotton textiles and clothes, and repeated crises of over- or underproduction of different crops. None of this, however, prevented the reformers from announcing the success of their plans. We should see the significance of these endless reports and announcements less as marking progress along the path of capitalist development, but more as constantly reiterating the language of market capitalism, thereby reproducing the impression that we know what capitalism is and that its unfolding determines our history.
zh: 阅读自由市场改革倡导者关于埃及农业的建议和报告，令人吃惊的是，他们的叙述中几乎完全没有埃及农村的任何细节或特殊性。在他们的文字里遇不到农民或村庄。缺失的东西还多得多。许多最彻底的改革建议缺乏充分证据支持。取消价格控制、作物配额、食品补贴和佃农保护的种种要求，是在对这些计划的效果及其取消后可能产生的后果没有可靠了解的情况下提出的。取消它们的结果是农业增长率下降、种植结构偏离棉花等高价值作物、埃及最有价值的制成品出口——棉纺织品和服装——大幅下滑，以及各种作物反复出现生产过剩或生产不足的危机。然而这一切并未妨碍改革者宣布其计划成功。我们不应把这些没完没了的报告和宣告的意义主要看作标志着资本主义发展道路上的进展，而应看作不断重申市场资本主义的语言，从而再生产这样一种印象：我们知道资本主义是什么，而且它的展开决定了我们的历史。

en: The policy conferences, IMF documents, government programs, consulting reports, statistical information, newspaper announcements, and academic papers were part of the continuing project to format and reproduce the Egyptian economy. Once again, we should not mistake this economy for a freestanding object, but examine it as the relationship between expertise and the world to which it refers—a world that, on closer inspection, never has the simplicity, logic, or fixedness that the expertise of economics assumes.
zh: 政策会议、IMF文件、政府计划、咨询报告、统计信息、报纸公告和学术论文，都是持续构建并再生产埃及经济这一工程的一部分。我们再次不应把这种经济误认为一个独立自存的对象，而应把它当作专业知识与其所指世界之间的关系来考察——而这个世界，细加审视，从来不具备经济学专业知识所假定的那种简单性、逻辑性或固定性。

en: How, then, can we understand rural Egypt and its relation to the market system (including its relation to this economic expertise)? There have so far been two alternatives, broadly speaking, neither without problems.

One points to a basic distinction in rural society between small peasant households, usually defined as those farming less than five acres, where production is oriented toward subsistence and the reproduction of the household, and capitalist farming integrated into national and international markets. The two kinds of farming are related, for the market-sector farms recruit wage laborers from among the landless and the smallest owners in the subsistence sector. The relationship allows the market sector to externalize the process of reproducing its labor force, since the costs are carried by the subsistence sector, which is dependent on jobs in the market sector for its survival.
zh: 那么，我们该如何理解埃及农村及其与市场体系的关系（包括与这种经济学专业知识的关系）？迄今为止，大致有两种替代性理解，二者各有问题。
一种指出农村社会中的一个基本区分：一方面是小农家庭，通常定义为耕种不足五费丹者，其生产面向生计和家庭再生产；另一方面是融入全国和国际市场的资本主义农业。这两种农业相互关联，因为市场部门的农场从无地者和生计部门中土地最少的农户里招募雇工。这种关系使市场部门得以将劳动力再生产过程外部化，因为其成本由生计部门承担，而生计部门又依赖市场部门的就业机会来维持生存。

en: By taking seriously the subsistence household as a form of production and examining the methods of articulation between the household and capitalist sectors, the aim of this approach was to uncover the diversity of strategies with which rural populations try to resist or accommodate the penetration of capital, without reducing the phenomenon to the stubbornness of tradition or a mere delay in the process of proletarianization driven by the global expansion of capitalism.
Such an approach, it was hoped, would relocate the principal dynamic of change within rather than outside Middle Eastern societies and enable them to “recapture their own history”
zh: 这种方法的目的是：认真对待作为生产方式的家户生计，考察家户部门与资本主义部门之间的接合方式，从而揭示农村人口用以抵抗或适应资本渗透的多样化策略，而不把这一现象化约为传统的顽固，或化约为资本主义全球扩张所推动的无产阶级化过程中的单纯延迟。
人们希望这种方法能把变化的主要动力置于中东社会内部而非外部，使它们能够“重新夺回自己的历史”

en: The problem with this way of thinking is that “their own history” must be a history outside capitalism yet, except in the writings of a Richard Critchfield, the outside of capitalism is not a place one can easily find.

The history of capitalism has to be written as the history of the West, as a history of others, so to recover a different history, the people of rural Egypt must see themselves outside the dynamic of capitalism. Here, it is hoped, they can locate a “dynamic” of their own. As we saw in the discussion of the ʿizba system in chapter 2, however, and as studies of the eighteenth century and earlier periods have shown, the history of rural Egypt has never been outside what is called the history of capitalism. At the end of the twentieth century, as this chapter has discussed, there was no selfcontained “subsistence sector” in simple articulation with a sector external to itself called the market. There would be no coherent way to draw a line between the two. The difficulty in finding any analytic or descriptive method of separating the noncapitalist from the capitalist was what brought the theories of “the articulation of modes of production,” as this problem became known, to a halt. A review essay concluded that the “almost infinitely multiplex and variable relations” that characterized socalled noncapitalist farming in the Third World made it difficult to explain “how a single mode of production can combine so large a number of variant ‘forms.’ “ Its articulation with capitalist modes, the conclusion continued, involving links at several levels, heterogenous in form and content, “can mean little more than a (necessary) recognition of a level of interconnection, while presupposing almost nothing about its precise shape or character.” In the end, all that could be offered was the hope that “what formulations like this lack in rigour, they more than make up for in vigour: they point unmistakably to the realities of our time, even if they do not do much as yet to unravel them.”
zh: 这种思路的问题在于，“他们自己的历史”必须是一部资本主义之外的历史，然而除了像理查德·克里奇菲尔德那样的作者笔下，资本主义的“外面”并不是一个容易找到的位置。

资本主义的历史不得不写成西方的历史，写成他者的历史；因此，要恢复一种不同的历史，埃及农村人民必须把自己看作处于资本主义动力之外。人们希望，在这里他们能找到属于自己的“动力”。然而，正如我们在第2章讨论ʿizba制度时所看到的，也如对18世纪及更早时期的研究所表明的，埃及农村的历史从未处于所谓资本主义历史之外。正如本章所论，在20世纪末，并不存在一个自足的“生计部门”，与一个被称为市场的外部部门保持简单的接合关系。也不可能以任何连贯的方式在两者之间划出一条界线。难以找到任何分析或描述方法来区分非资本主义与资本主义，正是这一点使所谓“生产方式接合”理论陷入停顿。一篇综述文章得出结论：第三世界所谓非资本主义农业所具有的“几乎无限多重而可变的关系”，使人们难以解释“一种生产方式如何能结合如此大量变异的‘形式’”。文章继续总结说，它与资本主义生产方式——涉及多个层次、形式和内容异质的联系——的接合，“所能意味的，至多不过是对某一相互联系层次的（必要）承认，而对这种联系的确切形态或性质几乎不预设任何东西。”最终所能提供的，只是一种希望：“这类表述所缺乏的严谨，被其活力所大大弥补：它们明确无误地指向我们时代的现实，尽管迄今为止对解开这些现实还助益不多。”

en: The second approach was to reject the idea that the household sector remained intact as it was incorporated into the wider capitalist system, or that its articulation with the capitalist sector could be thought of as an external relation.

It described household-based farmers either as small capitalists, stressing the variety of ways in which they dealt with the market and the entrepreneurial skill with which they turned meager resources into a basis for survival, or as petty commodity producers, meaning those who combined the role of capital and worker, and were thus capitalists who exploit themselves.

This way of thinking appeared to make better sense of the complexity of social relations and the central role of small farmers in what is called the market system. But in stressing the role of household farmers within capitalism it presented no real alternative to the story of the market. This means that what happened in rural Egypt was ultimately ascribed to the logic of capital. Other sorts of elements played only a secondary role and did not affect the development of capitalism itself.
zh: 第二种方法拒绝这样的观念：家户部门在被纳入更广泛的资本主义体系时仍保持完整，或者它与资本主义部门的接合可以被看作一种外部关系。
它把以家户为基础的农民要么描述为小资本家，强调他们应对市场方式的多样性，以及他们凭借企业家才能把微薄资源转化为生存基础；要么描述为小商品生产者，即同时扮演资本和工人角色的人，因而是自我剥削的资本家。
这种思路似乎能更好地解释社会关系的复杂性，以及小农在所谓市场体系中的核心作用。但在强调家户农民在资本主义内部的作用时，它并没有提出真正替代市场故事的方案。这意味着埃及农村所发生的一切最终都被归因于资本的逻辑。其他类型的因素只起次要作用，不影响资本主义本身的发展。

en: There is an alternative to both these approaches, as Gibson and Graham illustrate in the different context of the global finance industry.

It would start by questioning what is at stake in the assumption that there is some universal social form called capitalism, to which Egyptian farmers relate, and in relation to which they are to be explained. The various processes described as capitalist or market are not a self-contained system, imported intact into rural Egypt, whether in the nineteenth-century expansion of capitalism or in the late-twentieth-century free-market reforms. One of the proponents of the reforms in Egyptian agriculture argued that their introduction required “a seamless web” of simultaneous changes in the agricultural system (“seamless web” being the phrase introduced by the economist Jeffrey Sachs to characterize shock therapy, the disastrous program he advocated for Russia and Eastern Europe).

The expansion of the market could not be seamless, however, for it had to be stitched together out of people and practices already involved in a multitude of agrarian and other social relations. The project of free-market capitalism not only encountered this range of existing practice, it depended upon it to proceed. In the village, as we saw, the major cash crop was sugarcane, whose profitability rested upon the use of unpaid, nonmarket labor for harvesting. The majority of cane growers, moreover, produced a cash crop not as market entrepreneurs but to support a larger system of self-provisioning. Self-provisioning itself was not incidental to the free-market project. The goal of capitalist expansion through lower wages required farm workers who avoided the market cost of food by growing and processing many of their own consumption needs directly. Following the reforms, crops intended mostly for the farm household accounted for more than two-thirds of the crop area. Even production intended for the market was often based on forms of organization that cannot easily be described as capitalist, structured neither by the price system of a market nor by the relationship between wage labor and capital—such as the compulsory labor of the military production sector, the oligopolies that controlled commercial animal raising, or the forms of patronage and kinship ties through which local merchants like the Qinawis or large-scale farmers like Salim managed their operations.
zh: 还存在一种不同于上述两种方法的替代方案，吉布森和格雷厄姆在全球金融业这一不同语境中对此作了说明。

它将首先质疑这样一种假定所涉及的关键问题：存在某种叫作资本主义的普遍社会形式，埃及农民与之发生关系，并要参照它来解释埃及农民。那些被描述为资本主义或市场的各种过程并非一个自足的系统，无论是19世纪资本主义扩张，还是20世纪末的自由市场改革，都没有把它完整地输入埃及农村。埃及农业改革的一位支持者主张，引入这些改革需要在农业体系中同时进行“一张无缝之网”式的变革（“无缝之网”是经济学家杰弗里·萨克斯引入的说法，用以描述他为俄罗斯和东欧鼓吹的灾难性计划“休克疗法”）。

然而，市场的扩张不可能是无缝的，因为它必须由已经卷入众多农业及其他社会关系的人和实践中拼缝而成。自由市场资本主义计划不仅遭遇了这一系列既有实践，而且依赖它才得以推进。在村里，如我们所见，主要经济作物是甘蔗，其利润依靠使用无偿的非市场劳动进行收割。此外，大多数甘蔗种植者生产经济作物并非作为市场企业家，而是为了支持一个更大的自给自足体系。自给自足本身对自由市场计划并非无关紧要。通过压低工资实现资本主义扩张的目标，需要农工直接种植和加工自己的许多消费所需，从而避开食品的市场成本。改革之后，主要供农场家户自用的作物占作物面积的三分之二以上。甚至面向市场的生产也常常建立在难以简单称为资本主义的组织形式上，既不由市场的价格体系结构而成，也不由雇佣劳动与资本的关系结构而成——例如军事生产部门的强制劳动、控制商业化畜牧业的寡头，或齐纳维家族这样的本地商人和萨利姆这样的大农场主借以经营其业务的庇护关系和亲属纽带。

en: The picture of rural Egypt that emerges was not a system of small commodity producers incorporated into a larger capitalist economy. Nor, however, was there a separate noncapitalist sector in articulation with a market system. Rather, the so-called capitalist agriculture encouraged by the freemarket reforms included and depended upon a far wider range of practices that do not fit with any common definition of the essential nature of capitalism. These apparently noncapitalist elements were so numerous and so central that they shaped the outcome of the reforms. The clearest example of this was that when the government relaxed its crop quotas and acreage controls there followed a boom not in market and export crops, but in staples and self-provisioning. When it relaxed its control of the marketing of farm products there followed not a free-market system but family-based cartels and price fixing on one side and the reintroduction of floor prices and acreage controls on the other. Advocates of the market attributed these setbacks and disruptions to the incomplete nature of the reforms, or the improper sequence, or unanticipated side effects. In other words, they ascribed the setbacks to the failure to introduce the market as a seamless web. Instead we should see them not as a coordinated resistance to the market by people making an alternative history, but as the displacements and reformulations that occur because of the dependence of so-called capitalist arrangements on such a multitude of seemingly noncapitalist logics. Given the dependence, these other logics no longer deserve the label of noncapitalist. But once we introduce them into the dynamic of capital, any attempt to attribute an essence to capitalism has to be abandoned.
zh: 由此浮现的埃及农村图景，并不是一个被纳入更大资本主义经济的小商品生产者体系。然而，也不存在一个与市场体系接合的独立非资本主义部门。相反，自由市场改革所鼓励的所谓资本主义农业，包含并依赖于远为广泛的各种实践，而这些实践不符合关于资本主义本质的任何通常定义。这些表面上非资本主义的要素数量如此之多、地位如此核心，以至于塑造了改革的结果。最清楚的例子是：当政府放松作物配额和种植面积控制时，随之出现的繁荣不在市场和出口作物，而在主粮和自给自足生产。当它放松对农产品销售的控制时，随之出现的不是自由市场体系，而是一方面以家族为基础的卡特尔和价格操纵，另一方面是保底价格和面积控制的重新引入。市场的倡导者把这些挫折和混乱归因于改革不彻底、次序不当，或未预料的副作用。换言之，他们把这些挫折归因于未能把市场作为一张无缝之网引入。相反，我们不应把它们看作人们创造另类历史而对市场进行的协调抵抗，而应看作由于所谓资本主义安排依赖于如此众多表面上非资本主义的逻辑而产生的位移和重新表述。鉴于这种依赖，这些其他逻辑便不再配得上“非资本主义”的标签。但一旦把它们引入资本的动力之中，任何赋予资本主义以本质的尝试都必须放弃。

en: The forms of displacement and reformulation I have described are not in any sense merely a characteristic of transitional arrangements, where supposed market principles are introduced into a nonmarket system. As my discussions of the role of subsidies in U.S. agriculture, of slavery in the origins of capitalism, and of the world sugar and grain markets indicate, these displacements are found everywhere. They are a characteristic of what is called advanced capitalism just as much as they are of situations labeled transitional. At the same time, the conclusion to be drawn is not that the situation in rural Egypt is therefore essentially no different from that of American farmers, or that the local reformulations might be celebrated as a coherent or organized challenge to the project of global capitalism. The project remains one that has immense concentrations of power and resources on its side. The conclusion, rather, is that we need to become much more attentive to the failures, diversions, and redirections of the project. The power of what we call capitalism rests increasingly on its ability to portray itself as a unique and universal form, on reproducing a view of history and of economics in which the market is the universal system, constituted and propelled forward by the power of its own interior logic. The displacements and reformulations of the capitalist project show its dependence on arrangements and forces that this logic needs to portray as noncapitalist. By revealing the absence of an interior logic, they require us to look elsewhere for its power.
zh: 我所描述的这些位移和重新表述形式，绝不是仅仅属于过渡性安排的特征——即把所谓的市场原则引入非市场体系的安排。正如我对补贴在美国农业中的作用、奴隶制在资本主义起源中的作用，以及世界食糖和谷物市场的讨论所表明的，这些位移无处不在。它们既是被称为发达资本主义的特征，也同样是被贴上“过渡性”标签的情形的特征。与此同时，由此得出的结论并不是埃及农村的状况因此本质上与美国农民无异，也不是地方性的重新表述可以赞颂为对全球资本主义计划连贯而有组织的挑战。这一计划仍然拥有大量集中的权力和资源站在它一边。结论毋宁是，我们需要更加关注这一计划的失败、转向和改道。我们所谓的资本主义，其力量越来越依赖于它把自己描绘成一种独特而普遍的形式的能力，依赖于再生产这样一种历史观和经济学观：市场是普遍体系，由自身内在逻辑的力量构成并推动前进。资本主义计划的位移和重新表述，显示出它依赖于这种逻辑需要描绘为非资本主义的安排和力量。它们揭示了内在逻辑的缺失，从而要求我们到别处去寻找它的力量。

en: “Homoficence” was the term introduced by Aidan Foster Carter in his discussion of the work of Pierre-Philippe Rey, Colonialisme, néo-colonialisme, et transition au capitalisme (Paris: Maspero, 1971). The concept of the homoficence of capitalism, Foster Carter suggested, would make it possible “to preserve the coherence of Marxism.” The phrasing is revealing. It used to be hoped that Marxism would help reveal the incoherence of capitalism. Instead, capitalism was to be rendered homificent, to preserve the coherence of a certain kind of Marxism. “The Modes of Production Controversy,” New Left Review, no. 107 (Jan.–Feb. 1978): 47–77.

en: There is no space in this chapter to give a full account of the political economy of the village, or to discuss the ways tourism affects it. Briefly, scores of households derive some income from tourism or the related industry of archaeology, typically by employment as government workers or guards at the archaeological sites, as seasonal workers on archaeological excavations, or as unskilled employees of the hotels in Luxor and the Nile cruise ships based there. This low-paid work provides a supplement to farm income, rarely an alternative. Only a handful of households have made large profits from tourism, by finding the capital to invest in building a budget-class hotel or providing tourist transportation. The effects of tourism employment are, first, that fewer men have had to migrate elsewhere to find work (although many have migrated, either to Cairo, the tourist towns of the Red Sea coast, or the Gulf states); second, many households are vulnerable to the repeated contraction of the tourist industry in periods of political instability or violence; and third, the village does not specialize in labor-intensive farming, such as large-scale vegetable production (villages to the south, between Armant and Esna, supply the large demand for vegetables for the Luxor tourist trade), or in other nonfarm industries such as weaving, furniture making, brick making, or pottery found in neighboring villages. See Timothy Mitchell, “Worlds Apart: An Egyptian Village and the International Tourism Industry,” Middle East Report, no. 196 (Sept.–Oct. 1995): 8–11, 23.
zh: 本章无篇幅详述该村的政治经济学，也无法讨论旅游业影响该村的方式。简言之，有几十户人家从旅游业或相关的考古业获得一些收入，通常是受雇为考古遗址的政府工作人员或守卫、考古发掘的季节工，或卢克索旅馆和以此为母港的尼罗河游轮上的非熟练雇员。这类低薪工作补充农业收入，很少能替代农业。只有少数几户从旅游业赚了大钱，办法是筹到资本，投资建一家经济型旅馆或提供旅游交通。旅游业就业的影响是：第一，需要外出找活的男人少了（尽管仍有许多人外流，或去开罗，或去红海沿岸的旅游城镇，或去海湾国家）；第二，许多家庭易受政治不稳定或暴力时期旅游业反复萎缩的冲击；第三，本村没有专门发展劳动密集型农业，如大规模蔬菜生产（南边阿尔曼特与伊什纳之间的村庄为卢克索旅游业的大量蔬菜需求供货），也没有发展邻近村庄可见的织造、家具制造、制砖或制陶等其他非农行业。见 Timothy Mitchell, “Worlds Apart: An Egyptian Village and the International Tourism Industry,” Middle East Report, no. 196 (Sept.–Oct. 1995): 8–11, 23.

en: I have changed the names and certain descriptions of people in the village. As in previous chapters, the term “acre” here refers to an Egyptian acre, or feddan, equal to 0.42 hectares or 1.038 British or U.S. acres. It is divided into 24 qirats, each qirat being 175 square meters.
zh: 我已更改村中人物的姓名和某些描述。与前几章一样，这里的“acre”指埃及土地单位费丹，等于0.42公顷或1.038英亩（英美制）。一费丹分为24基拉特，每基拉特175平方米。

en: The methods are described in Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, National Methods of Collecting Agricultural Statistics, Supplement no. 18, Egypt, Mexico, Puerto Rico (Rome: FAO, 1983), 1–3.

en: Cotton is an interesting example. The area planted with cotton is said to have dropped by 17 percent in the early years of the reforms, from 1.05 million acres in 1986 to 880,000 acres in 1993. Yet total production remained virtually unchanged, dropping from 6.9 million qantars (hundredweight) to 6.88 million. The official figures conclude that the decline in acreage was exactly balanced by a dramatic and largely unexplained increase in yield, from 6.54 to 7.78 qantars per acre. An alternative explanation would be that the ending of quotas and compulsory procurement prices for wheat and other food crops removed the need to misreport the area planted with cotton, and that its actual area, yield, and production remained constant.
zh: 棉花是个有趣的例子。据说改革头几年棉花种植面积下降了17%，从1986年的105万费丹降至1993年的88万费丹。然而总产量几乎不变，从690万坎塔尔（qantar，英担）降至688万。官方数字由此断定，面积下降恰好被单产的急剧上升所抵消——单产从每费丹6.54坎塔尔升至7.78坎塔尔，而这一上升在很大程度上未加解释。另一种解释是：小麦和其他粮食作物的配额和强制收购价格取消后，不再需要谎报棉花种植面积，而棉花的实际面积、单产和产量一直未变。

en: There are other examples of this move toward self-provisioning elsewhere in the world following the promotion of free-market agriculture. An interesting case is that of cotton farmers in Andra Pradesh in southern India, who switched to growing chickpeas. The switch ended their battles with pests and markets and their need for extensive fertilizer suppliers and labor. Chickpeas, which are nitrogen-fixing, restored the fertility of the soil and ended protein malnourishment in local diets. International Crop Research Institute for the Semi-Arid Tropics,“A Silent Pulse Revolution,” Food From Thought, available at http://www.icrisat.org/text/pubs/fft/gpub2.html.
zh: 世界上其他地方在推广自由市场农业之后，也有这种转向自给自足的例子。印度南部安得拉邦的棉农就是一个有趣的例子，他们改种鹰嘴豆。这一转变结束了他们与害虫和市场的斗争，也不再需要大量化肥供应商和劳动力。鹰嘴豆能固氮，恢复了土壤肥力，并结束了当地饮食中的蛋白质营养不良。International Crop Research Institute for the Semi-Arid Tropics, “A Silent Pulse Revolution,” Food From Thought, available at http://www.icrisat.org/text/pubs/fft/gpub2.html.

en: In the case of cotton, the area planted began (or continued) to decline sharply following the removal of acreage controls in 1992 and 1993, dropping from 850,000 acres in 1990 to 720,000 in 1994 and 710,000 in 1995. The Ministry of Supply had to raise procurement prices as much as 30 percent above world market prices to maintain supplies to the textile industry. (Khedr, Ehrich, and Fletcher, “The Agricultural Policy Reforms,” 63, 67). Marketing was partially deregulated in 1994, but the government retained a floor price. (There were reports that a single merchant, Mahmud Wahba, monopolized the commercial market that year.) In 1996 import restrictions were lifted and merchants refused to buy domestic cotton at the floor price of E£500 per qantar. The government spent E£1 billion purchasing the surplus crop. In January 1997 the Finance Ministry, supported by merchants and private sector firms, called for the floor price to be abolished, but the Ministries of Agriculture and Supply insisted successfully that the market could not be deregulated and price supports had to be retained. The government retained the E£500 floor price and announced that cotton acreage would be extended to one million acres (“alHukuma tahammalat 522 malyun ginaih li-ʾl-mawsim al-qutn 96/97,” alAhram al-iqtisadi, Feb. 24, 1997, 40; Jamal Imbabi, “Tusaʿid al-khilafat baina al-ziraʿa wa-ʾl-maliyya wa-ʾl-rayy hawla tahdid misahat al-ruz wa-ʾl-qutn,” al-Shaʿb, Jan. 31, 1997, 8; “Ziraʿat milyun faddan qutnan fi al-mawsim al-qadim,” al-Ahram, Feb. 7, 1997, 1). As international cotton prices continued to fall, the higher Egyptian floor price caused exports of cotton textiles and clothes to decline sharply. Exports in 1996 were 21 percent lower than 1995 (Business Today Egypt, Mar. 1997, 12).
zh: 就棉花而言，1992年和1993年取消面积控制后，种植面积开始（或继续）急剧下降，从1990年的85万费丹降至1994年的72万费丹、1995年的71万费丹。供应部不得不把收购价提高到世界市场价格的30%以上，以维持对纺织业的供应。（Khedr, Ehrich, and Fletcher, “The Agricultural Policy Reforms,” 63, 67）。1994年销售部分放开，但政府保留了保底价格。（有报道说，当年一个叫马哈茂德·瓦赫巴的商人垄断了商业市场。）1996年进口限制取消，商人拒绝按每坎塔尔500埃镑的保底价购买国产棉花。政府花了10亿埃镑购买剩余作物。1997年1月，财政部在商人和私营企业支持下呼吁取消保底价，但农业部和供应部成功坚持市场不能放开、价格支持必须保留。政府保留了500埃镑的保底价，并宣布棉花种植面积将扩大到100万费丹（“alHukuma tahammalat 522 malyun ginaih li-ʾl-mawsim al-qutn 96/97,” al-Ahram al-iqtisadi, Feb. 24, 1997, 40; Jamal Imbabi, “Tusaʿid al-khilafat baina al-ziraʿa wa-ʾl-maliyya wa-ʾl-rayy hawla tahdid misahat al-ruz wa-ʾl-qutn,” al-Shaʿb, Jan. 31, 1997, 8; “Ziraʿat milyun faddan qutnan fi al-mawsim al-qadim,” al-Ahram, Feb. 7, 1997, 1）。随着国际棉价持续下跌，埃及较高的保底价导致棉纺织品和服装出口急剧下降。1996年出口比1995年低21%（Business Today Egypt, Mar. 1997, 12）。

en: See Saad Nassar, Fenton Sands, Mohamed A. Omran, and Ronald Krenz, “Crop Production Responses to the Agricultural Policy Reforms,” in Fletcher, ed., Egypt’s Agriculture in a Reform Era, 84–111, table 5.1, 92. Unlike wheat, rice became less profitable during the reform period (Khedr, Ehrich, and Fletcher , “The Agricultural Policy Reforms,” 69). This evidence supports the argument that farmers were shifting to staples to avoid the market rather than in response to market signals.
zh: 见 Saad Nassar, Fenton Sands, Mohamed A. Omran, and Ronald Krenz, “Crop Production Responses to the Agricultural Policy Reforms,” in Fletcher, ed., Egypt’s Agriculture in a Reform Era, 84–111, table 5.1, 92。与小麦不同，水稻在改革时期利润下降（Khedr, Ehrich, and Fletcher, “The Agricultural Policy Reforms,” 69）。这一证据支持这样的论点：农民转向主粮是为了避开市场，而不是回应市场信号。

en: The government limited the rice area to 900,000 acres in 1996, but farmers planted 1.2 million acres (Imbabi, “Tusaʿid al-khilafat,” 8). Production that year reached 4.5 million tons, but exports dropped from a previous high of 800,000 tons to only 200,000 (“Maʿrakat al-ruzz ma zalat mustamirra,” Akhbar al-yawm, Nov. 23, 1996, 22). The Minister of Public Works and Water Supplies wanted to limit the use of irrigation water for rice in part because he was the proponent of ambitious land reclamation schemes that would require vast new supplies of water. Shortly before his death in November 1996 he won the president’s support for a plan to create a “New Delta,” the Toshka project in southern Egypt (see chapter 9). An important benefit of rice cultivation was that the large amount of water used in its irrigation prevented the ingress of salt water in the coastal regions of the northern Delta. Nadir Nur al-Din Muhammad, “Hiwarat al-ziraʿiyyin hawl al-miyah wa-ʾl-aruzz wa-ʾl-qasab,” al-Ahram, Mar. 11, 2001, 12.
zh: 1996年政府将水稻面积限制在90万费丹，但农民种了120万费丹（Imbabi, “Tusaʿid al-khilafat,” 8）。当年产量达到450万吨，但出口从先前80万吨的高点降至仅20万吨（“Maʿrakat al-ruzz ma zalat mustamirra,” Akhbar al-yawm, Nov. 23, 1996, 22）。公共工程与供水部长想限制水稻的灌溉用水，部分原因是他本人是一项雄心勃勃的垦荒计划的推动者，该计划需要大量新增水源。1996年11月去世前不久，他争取到总统支持一项建立“新三角洲”的计划，即埃及南部的托什卡项目（见第9章）。种植水稻的一项重要好处是，其灌溉所用的大量水防止了三角洲北部沿海地区的海水入侵。Nadir Nur al-Din Muhammad, “Hiwarat al-ziraʿiyyin hawl al-miyah wa-ʾl-aruzz wa-ʾl-qasab,” al-Ahram, Mar. 11, 2001, 12.

en: Crop areas for 1990–93 (percent of total) were: berseem 21.7, maize 19.6, wheat 18.0, rice 10.9, cotton 8.8, vegetables 6.2, others 14.8. Nassar et al., “Crop Production Responses to the Agricultural Policy Reforms,” 91. The four largest crops, accounting for 70.2 percent of the crop area, were produced mostly for household use. A survey in 1989–91 of 665 farmers in three different parts of the country found that about 70 percent of those growing wheat, almost 80 percent of those growing maize, and nearly half of those growing berseem used the crop entirely for their own consumption. Most of the rest sold only a part of the crop, and often to other households within the village, almost entirely so in the case of berseem. Mehanna et al., Farmers and Merchants, 68–77.
zh: 1990—93年的作物面积（占总面积百分比）为：亚历山大车轴草21.7，玉米19.6，小麦18.0，水稻10.9，棉花8.8，蔬菜6.2，其他14.8。Nassar et al., “Crop Production Responses to the Agricultural Policy Reforms,” 91。最大的四种作物占作物面积的70.2%，主要供家庭使用。1989—91年对全国三个不同地区665名农民的一项调查发现，种小麦者约70%、种玉米者近80%、种车轴草者近一半完全用于自家消费。其余多数只出售一部分收成，而且常常卖给村内其他家庭，车轴草几乎全部如此。Mehanna et al., Farmers and Merchants, 68–77.

en: In 1983 the sugar protection policies of the industrialized countries caused Third World producers to lose $7.4 billion in revenue, cutting their real income by $2.1 billion and increasing price instability by 25 percent. The World Bank, World Development Report 1986 (Washington, D.C.: World Bank, 1986); World Commission on Environment and Development, Our Common Future (Oxford: Oxford University Press, 1987), 82.
zh: 1983年，工业化国家的食糖保护政策使第三世界生产国损失74亿美元收入，实际收入减少21亿美元，并使价格不稳定加剧25%。The World Bank, World Development Report 1986 (Washington, D.C.: World Bank, 1986); World Commission on Environment and Development, Our Common Future (Oxford: Oxford University Press, 1987), 82.

en: Brazil accounted for 28 percent of the increase in production from 1993/94 to 1999/2000. Its dominant role in the market was due to lower production costs, but also to its alcohol sector providing an alternative outlet for cane. United States Department of Agriculture, Foreign Agricultural Service, “Sugar: World Markets and Trade,” Circular, Nov. 1999, at http://www.fas. usda.gov/htp2/sugar/1999/november/toc.html; Economist, Nov. 27, 1999, 108.

en: The Center for Responsive Politics cites the sugar industry as a leading example of how pressure groups use money to influence voting in Congress. In 1996 the industry paid an average of $13,000 to the sixty-one senators who voted to preserve sugar subsidies, compared to an average of $1,500 to those who voted against. Cashing In: A Guide to Money, Votes, and Public Policy in the 104th Congress (Washington, D.C.: Center for Responsive Politics, Jan. 1997). The price of U.S. sugar also included the cost of the embargo on Cuban sugar, another part of the protection system.
zh: 响应政治中心把食糖业列为压力集团用金钱影响国会投票的典型例子。1996年，该行业平均向投票支持保留食糖补贴的61位参议员支付13,000美元，而向投反对票的参议员平均支付1,500美元。Cashing In: A Guide to Money, Votes, and Public Policy in the 104th Congress (Washington, D.C.: Center for Responsive Politics, Jan. 1997). 美国食糖价格还包括对古巴食糖禁运的成本，这是保护体系的另一部分。

en: Friedmann, “World Market, State, and Family Farm,” 582–86.
zh: Friedmann, “World Market, State, and Family Farm,” 582–86.

en: The figure of $29,000 is from the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development, cited Kevin Watkins,“Fast Route to Poverty,” Guardian Weekly, Feb. 16, 1997, 29. Egypt’s 1994 per capita GNP was estimated at $720 (World Bank, World Development Report 1996 [New York: Oxford University Press, 1996], table 1, 188). In 1991, annual agricultural producer subsidies were estimated at $83 billion in the European Union, $34 billion in the United States, and $30 billion in Japan. These subsidies represented 30 percent of farmers’ incomes in the United States, 49 percent in the EU, and 66 percent in Japan (Economist, Dec. 12, 1992). Despite these subsidies, U.S. farmers required extensive nonfarm income to survive. In 1992, income from nonfarm sources represented on average 41 percent of farm operator households’ income. United States Department of Agriculture, Agriculture Fact Book 1994 (Washington, D.C.: USDA, 1994), 33.
zh: 29,000美元的数字来自经济合作与发展组织，转引自 Kevin Watkins, “Fast Route to Poverty,” Guardian Weekly, Feb. 16, 1997, 29。埃及1994年人均国民生产总值估计为720美元（World Bank, World Development Report 1996 [New York: Oxford University Press, 1996], table 1, 188）。1991年，欧盟的农业生产者补贴估计为830亿美元，美国为340亿美元，日本为300亿美元。这些补贴占农民收入的比例分别为：美国30%、欧盟49%、日本66%（Economist, Dec. 12, 1992）。尽管有这些补贴，美国农民仍需要大量非农收入才能维持。1992年，非农来源收入平均占农场经营者家庭收入的41%。United States Department of Agriculture, Agriculture Fact Book 1994 (Washington, D.C.: USDA, 1994), 33.

en: In 1993 the U.S. food stamp program served 27 million people and cost $27 billion (fiscal year 1994). Another $8 billion was spent on other subsidized food programs, including the school lunch and the Women, Infants and Children programs. Ibid., 76–79.
zh: 1993年，美国食品券计划服务2700万人，花费270亿美元（1994财年）。另有80亿美元用于其他补贴食品计划，包括学校午餐和“妇女、婴儿与儿童”计划。Ibid., 76–79.

zh: 阿代卜是一种干量单位，等于198升。一阿代卜小麦重150公斤。
